AI Accelerator的业务价值实现探讨 · 主持人：TomExploring how AI Accelerator creates business value · Host: Tom

从真实结果倒推Work backward from outcomes

从八组实践与失败经验出发，辨认业务结果、流程断点、知识输入和必须保留的人类判断；不把演示流畅写成已上线结果。Start from eight practices and failures to identify outcomes, flow breakpoints, knowledge inputs and human judgement; a smooth demo is not a launch result.

把能力放进流程Put capability into flow

让数据、语义、模型、Agent、Skill、页面与受控 Action 在同一条业务链上协同，明确权限、证据、回写和接管边界。Connect data, semantics, models, Agents, Skills, pages and controlled Actions in one business chain with explicit access, evidence, writeback and takeover boundaries.

从一次成功到重复交付From one success to repeatable delivery

Day 1 形成候选、风险和实施输入；Day 2 用真实业务与企业能力核验资产、组织和路线，最后确认继续、调整或停止的下一决策门。Day 1 forms candidates, risks and implementation inputs. Day 2 validates assets, organization and route with real business and enterprise capability, then confirms the next gate.

共同语言：Shared language:场景、Owner、能力边界、证据、复用条件与下一决策门。Scene, Owner, capability boundary, evidence, reuse conditions and the next decision gate.

005 · MD §D1.2.0 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
MD §D1.2.0 · Day 1 · 八案例总览MD §D1.2.0 · Day 1 · Eight-case overview

八案例：从结果倒推可重复交付Eight cases: work backward from outcomes to repeatable delivery

每例后续都有预录视频位置与七段展开；结果数字、效率或组织变化只在证据核验后记录，不在此页造数。Every case has a video slot and seven-part deep dive later. Numbers, efficiency and organizational change are recorded only after evidence checks.

01UNIS 港口｜无头 AgentUNIS port | headless Agent

从 CSR ticket 识别高频、耗时、依赖经验的任务，由 Agent 辅助决策与执行，以更少人力、更高准确性与稳定性完成工作。Identify frequent, time-consuming, experience-dependent tasks from CSR tickets. Agents support decisions and execution to get work done with less manual effort, greater accuracy and consistency.

02WMS｜动态表单WMS | Dynamic Forms

现场直接对懂 WMS 的 Agent 说需求，当场生成能试用的任务页和工作台；是否发布由人决定。Floor staff describe a need to an Agent that knows WMS and get a working task screen or workbench on the spot; people decide what is released.

03Rate & Quote｜数据本体Rate & Quote | data ontology

让业务与开发共享语义，再连接分析页和业务表单。Create shared language for business and development, then connect analytics and forms.

04BO｜FDE 与专家验证BO | FDE and expert validation

规则、本体、样本与专家审核分开评测，准确性不外推。Evaluate rules, ontology, samples and expert review separately; do not extrapolate accuracy.

05Record & Reply｜知识采集Record & Reply | knowledge capture

用视频降低线下流程表达门槛，形成经审核的 SOP 草案。Use video to lower the barrier for offline-process capture and draft a reviewed SOP.

06CEC / Genesys｜观察到受控执行CEC / Genesys | observe to controlled action

经授权观察坐席流程，区分可自动、辅助和必须人工的动作。Observe agent flows with authorization and separate automatic, assisted and human-only actions.

07iCEO｜问答与决策边界iCEO | Q&A versus decision boundary

受控问答可单独验证；复杂经营决策不以演示代替业务合格。Controlled Q&A can be tested separately; complex operating decisions are not demo-qualified.

08其他坑｜法规、知识与模型投资Other pitfalls | law, knowledge and model investment

先补知识、权限和评测，再决定模型投资；必要时缩小、停止或转交。Stabilize knowledge, access and evaluation before model investment; narrow, stop or hand off when needed.

观看顺序Viewing order先确认业务结果和证据，再看前/后流程、实施与组织变化，最后填写ISS对标和重复交付条件。Confirm outcome and evidence first, then review before/after flow, implementation and organization, before recording ISS comparison and reuse conditions.

006 · MD §D1.2.1.1 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.1DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.1

从适合的任务切入：减少人工重复，让调度有据可依Start with suitable tasks: less manual work, better-informed dispatch

不只看发生次数，优先选择耗人力、规则清楚、容易验证的任务；对依赖经验的决策，先用数据与计算辅助判断。Prioritise suitability, not just frequency: labour-intensive tasks with clear rules and verifiable results. Support experience-led decisions with data and computation.

01 · OUTCOME

痛点与期望结果Pain and intended outcome

  • 邮件、PDF 录入和码头查询依赖人工，重复耗时。
  • 查询频次因人而异；派车主要靠直觉与经验，难以稳定比较方案。
  • 用 Agent 承接重复操作、辅助调度，目标是以更少人力更准确、稳定地完成工作。
  • 经验让计划可执行，计算让方案更优，实时变化驱动动态调整。
  • Reading emails and PDFs, entering data and checking terminals are repetitive manual work.
  • Checking frequency varies by person; intuition-led dispatch makes consistent comparison difficult.
  • Agents handle repetitive work and assist dispatch, aiming for less manual effort, greater accuracy and consistency.
  • Experience makes plans workable; computation improves choices; live changes drive adjustments.
02 · CURRENT FLOW

改造前流程Current workflow

  • 客户邮件 / PDF → CSR 提取箱号、ETA、发送日期等，录入系统。
  • 临近 ETA，人工逐个码头查询到港状态及免费期，每人每天约1–8轮。
  • 每区域每天约30–50名司机，安排150个集装箱的送／挂／还。
  • 任务顺序、到港时间、免费期、司机工时与空驶成本相互牵动，实时路况又不断打乱原计划，调度需要持续比较和调整。
  • Customer email / PDF → CSR enters container numbers, ETA, sent date and other details into the system.
  • Near ETA, staff check terminal websites for arrivals and free time, about 1–8 rounds per person daily.
  • Each region assigns roughly 30–50 drivers to delivery, drop and return work for 150 containers daily.
  • Task order, arrivals, free time, driver hours and empty-mile costs interact. Changing traffic disrupts plans, requiring continual comparison and adjustment.

重复操作消耗人力，复杂调度依赖个人经验。Repetitive work consumes labour; complex dispatch depends on individual experience.

预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：一组已脱敏 CSR ticket → 问题合并 → 一条运输任务的触发、交接、异常接管与回放。Suggested recording: redacted CSR tickets → issue merging → one transport task through trigger, handoff, exception takeover and replay.

请明确标注：真实 / 脱敏 / 模拟；不写假 src，不嵌外链播放器。Label clearly: real / redacted / simulated. No fake src and no external player.

007 · MD §D1.2.1.2 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.2DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.2

正常任务自动处理，异常交给人，派单保留人工选择Automate routine work, hand off exceptions, keep dispatch choices human

有依据才执行，有缺口就求助；不猜测，不编造，不为给出结果而凑数据。Act on evidence and ask for help when data is missing. Never guess, fabricate or invent data just to produce a result.

01 · DO

DO读取与录入DO reading and entry

  • 读取 DO，检查所需字段是否齐全。
  • 数据完整、校验正常，直接录入系统。
  • 缺少字段或无法确认，转入“Need Help”，由人工核实补充。
  • Read the DO and check all required fields.
  • Enter complete, validated data directly into the system.
  • Missing or uncertain fields go to “Need Help” for human verification and completion.
02 · TERMINAL

码头网站查询Terminal website queries

  • 不同网站有不同操作方式与箱号输入规则，例如部分网站要求去掉箱号首位。
  • 正常查询后，读取实际返回的集装箱信息。
  • 遇到反机器人限制、页面异常或查询失败，转入“Need Help”，由人工接管，不猜结果。
  • Websites differ in workflow and container-number format; some require removing the first character.
  • Read the container information actually returned by a successful query.
  • Anti-bot restrictions, page errors or failed queries go to “Need Help” for human takeover. Never guess results.
03 · DISPATCH

动态派单建议Dynamic dispatch recommendations

  • 每完成一个任务，根据当前限制与实时路况，建议下一个任务。
  • 人工可接受建议，也可拒绝并手动调整。
  • 人工调整时，记录调整原因，保留决策依据。
  • After each task, recommend the next one using current constraints and live traffic.
  • People may accept the recommendation, reject it or adjust the assignment manually.
  • Record the reason for each manual adjustment to preserve the decision rationale.
人机分工Human–Agent roles人不再逐项重复操作，而是处理异常、判断建议、保留最终决定权。People handle exceptions, assess recommendations and retain final authority instead of repeating every operation.

008 · MD §D1.2.1.3 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.3DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.3

先选适合的任务，再把规则、异常和人工反馈跑通Choose suitable tasks, then validate rules, exceptions and human feedback

01 · INPUT → FILTER

选对切入点Choose the right starting point

  • 从 CSR ticket 找出耗人力、规则清楚、容易验证的任务，不只按数量排序。
  • DO录入、码头查询先承接重复操作；复杂派单先提供建议。
  • 明确输入、结果与人工介入的位置。
  • Find labour-intensive tasks with clear rules and verifiable results in CSR tickets—not simply the most frequent.
  • Automate repetitive DO entry and terminal queries; start complex dispatch with recommendations.
  • Define inputs, outcomes and human intervention points.
02 · BUILD

把业务规则说清楚Make business rules explicit

  • DO需要哪些字段，什么情况可直接录入、什么情况转 Need Help。
  • 各码头网站的操作差异、箱号格式与查询异常。
  • 派单需要遵守的限制、路况依据，以及人工调整权限。
  • Define required DO fields, direct-entry conditions and when to route to Need Help.
  • Document terminal workflows, container-number formats and query exceptions.
  • Specify dispatch constraints, traffic inputs and human override authority.
03 · VALIDATE

用真实场景验证Validate with real scenarios

  • 用授权、脱敏的业务样本验证正常与异常路径。
  • 核对录入、查询结果是否准确，Need Help能否有效接管。
  • 检查派单建议是否符合限制、是否便于人工判断与调整。
  • Use authorised, redacted business samples to test normal and exception paths.
  • Check entry and query accuracy, and whether Need Help enables effective takeover.
  • Check that dispatch recommendations meet constraints and are easy to assess and adjust.
04 · ADOPT → IMPROVE

即时算成本，每日复盘改规则Compare costs now, refine rules daily

  • 每次人工调整，立即显示前后预计成本差异，由人工确认；每天结合调整原因复盘。
  • 人工方案成本更低，或成本更高但确有必要：查明原因，补齐规则，经验证后更新。
  • 成本更高且仅因习惯：写入提醒规则，下次提示额外成本，保留人工决定权。
  • Show the estimated cost difference immediately after each manual adjustment for human confirmation; review adjustments and their reasons daily.
  • If the human plan costs less, or costs more for a valid reason, identify why, fill rule gaps and validate before updating.
  • If higher cost comes only from habit, add a reminder rule to flag the extra cost next time, while retaining human authority.

怎么判断项目真的有效？How do we know the project works?

  • 做对了吗：信息是否准确，操作是否符合业务规则？
  • 做完了吗：多少任务自动完成，多少需要人工，有没有遗漏？
  • 人更省力了吗：同样的工作量，人工操作和跟进时间是否减少？
  • 整体更划算了吗：算上系统运行与维护费用，整体成本和业务结果是否改善？
  • 遇到问题接得住吗：异常能否及时交给人，并最终处理完成？

选定观察周期，与原有做法按相同标准比较；没有实测的数据，先标记待验证。

  • Is it correct? Is the information accurate, and do actions follow business rules?
  • Is it complete? How many tasks finish automatically, need human help or get missed?
  • Does it save effort? For the same workload, does manual work and follow-up take less time?
  • Is it worth the cost? Including system operation and maintenance, do overall costs and business outcomes improve?
  • Can people handle exceptions? Are problems handed off promptly and ultimately resolved?

Choose an observation period and compare with the previous process using the same standards. Mark unmeasured results as awaiting validation.

讨论Discussion谁是业务 Owner、专家审核人、接管人和运维人？验收分母、周期与质量等级由谁签认？Who are the business Owner, expert reviewer, takeover owner and operator? Who signs off denominator, period and quality grades?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.1.4
010 · MD §D1.2.1.5 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.5DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.5

ISS 的哪些工作，可以交给无头 Agent？Which ISS tasks can a headless Agent handle?

01 · TRIGGER

什么触发它What triggers it

  • 收到邮件、文件或新任务，自动开始处理。
  • 到达约定时间，主动查询、检查和跟进。
  • 任务完成或状态变化，触发下一步处理或建议。
  • Start automatically when an email, document or new task arrives.
  • Query, check and follow up at scheduled times.
  • Task completion or a status change triggers the next action or recommendation.
02 · BACKGROUND

它在后台负责什么What it handles in the background

  • 按明确规则读取信息、核对状态、调用系统。
  • 正常情况自动完成，不需要人逐次发指令。
  • 需要持续跟进的任务，按触发条件再次检查，直到完成或转人工。
  • Read information, check status and call systems according to clear rules.
  • Complete routine work automatically, without a new human prompt each time.
  • Recheck ongoing tasks when triggered, until completion or human handoff.
03 · HUMAN

什么时候找人When it asks for human help

  • 数据缺失、查询受阻或执行异常，进入 Need Help。
  • 需要业务判断时给出建议，由人决定。
  • 人工可拒绝或调整建议，并记录原因。
  • Route missing data, blocked queries or execution errors to Need Help.
  • Offer recommendations when business judgement is needed; people decide.
  • People may reject or adjust recommendations, with the reasons recorded.
讨论DiscussionISS 有没有一项工作，可以不再靠人反复盯着，而由事件触发、后台跟进，只在必要时找人？Which ISS task could be triggered by events and followed up in the background, involving people only when needed instead of requiring constant attention?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.1.5
011 · MD §D1.2.2.1 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.1DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.1

WMS 动态表单：需求不再层层转述，现场说出来就能试用WMS Dynamic Forms: say it on the floor, try it right away

仓库现场每天都有新需求：异常登记、状态采集、任务确认、临时看板。难的不是做出一个页面，而是让需求原样送达，做出来就符合 WMS 的字段、接口和规则。New floor needs arrive daily: exception logs, status capture, task checks, ad-hoc dashboards. The hard part is not the page but getting the need through intact and building it to WMS rules.

改造前：需求层层转述Before: the need is relayed hop by hop

01 · FIELD现场提出Floor asks
02 · RELAY支持/产品转述Support/PM relay
03 · BUILD开发/测试Build/test
04 · RELEASE上线再改重走Release, redo

每转述一次，背景、痛点和优先级就淡一分；周期长，上线后改一处又要重走整条链路。Each relay fades context, pain and priority; cycles are long, and one change after release reruns the whole chain.

改造后：说出来，当场就能用After: say it, use it on the spot

01 · SAY说出需求Say the need
02 · DRAFT生成初版First version
03 · TRY现场试用Try on the floor
04 · REVISE对话里修改Revise in chat

提出需求的人直接和懂 WMS 的 Agent 对话，一轮迭代在一次对话里完成；权限、校验和发布仍由 WMS 与人把关。The requester talks directly to an Agent that knows WMS, and one iteration fits in one conversation; WMS and people still hold access, validation and release.

证据边界｜真实：本地 WMS 的任务类型、页面定义、主数据、权限与审计。示意：动画画面、人物与单据号。待补：ISS 试点与改造前基线。Evidence | Real: task types, page definitions, master data, access and audit in local WMS. Illustrative: animation, people, document numbers. To add: ISS pilot and baseline.

演示视频｜Item WMS 动态表单（约 11 分 37 秒）Demo video | Item WMS Dynamic Forms (about 11:37)

HTML 场景动画＋旁白，不是录屏。三幕：巡检员上报破损（手机）→ 主管用工作台派工（Web）→ 执行人把坏货搬到坏货区（手机）。每个画面右上角标注真实机制或示意画面。HTML scene animation with narration, not a screen recording. Three acts: a patroller reports damage (mobile) → a supervisor dispatches from a workbench (web) → a worker moves the stock to the damage zone (mobile). Each scene is labelled real mechanism or illustration.

讨论DiscussionISS 现场哪一类需求最常在转述中走样？演示中哪些部分要换成 ISS 真实或脱敏数据再看一遍？Which ISS floor needs most often get distorted in relay? Which parts of the demo should be rerun on real or redacted ISS data?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.1
012 · MD §D1.2.2.2 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.2DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.2

改造后：需求方直接对 Agent 说，当场拿到能用的应用After: requesters talk to the Agent directly and get a working app on the spot

以一次库存破损为例：巡检员和主管各自对 Agent 说出需求，生成的三个应用串起发现 → 派工 → 入坏货区。终点不是表单提交，而是有证据的业务状态变化。One damage case: a patroller and a supervisor each tell the Agent what they need; the three apps it builds carry the case from discovery to the damage zone, ending in an evidenced state change.

01 · 巡检员 · 手机01 · PATROLLER · MOBILE

“看到破损就拍照上报”“Photo and report any damage I see”

  • 生成BUILTAgent 查本体与上报接口，给出计划卡；同意后生成巡检任务页（Dynamic Task）。The Agent checks the ontology and report API, proposes a plan, then builds a patrol task (Dynamic Task).
  • 试用TRY扫库位、扫 LPN 自动带出客户与物料；没拍照不能提交。Scanning location and LPN fills customer and item; no photo, no submit.
  • 结果RESULT生成 Inventory Issue，货况 Good → Damaged，这批货立即不可拣。An Inventory Issue is created and condition goes Good → Damaged; the stock can no longer be picked.

好用就保存为 Inventory Patrol 任务类型，供他人复用。If it works, save it as the Inventory Patrol task type for others to reuse.

02 · 主管 · WEB02 · SUPERVISOR · WEB

“做一个破损转移工作台”“Build me a damage-move workbench”

  • 生成BUILTAgent 写数据查询，先用真实数据预览，再起草页面（Dynamic Page）；草稿只有作者可见。The Agent writes the query, previews real data, then drafts the page (Dynamic Page), visible only to its author.
  • 发布RELEASE系统按页面调用的接口算出所需权限，主管确认后发布。WMS derives the required access from the APIs the page calls; the supervisor confirms and publishes.
  • 结果RESULT勾选两条 Issue、指派执行人，创建 Move Damage 任务；Issue 变为 In Progress。Select two Issues, assign a worker and create a Move Damage task; the Issues move to In Progress.

以主管本人权限调用，记录页面与版本。Runs with the supervisor's own access; page and version recorded.

03 · 主管搭建 · 执行人手机执行03 · SUPERVISOR BUILDS · WORKER RUNS

“把坏货搬到坏货区”“Move damaged stock to the damage zone”

  • 生成BUILTAgent 只组合一个标准步骤 Move Inventory，目的地按货况指向坏货区；试运行后发布。One standard step, Move Inventory, routed to the damage zone by condition; published after a trial run.
  • 执行RUN扫错库位直接被拒；按建议扫描放到 DMG-01，任务关闭。A wrong location is rejected; scan and place at the suggested DMG-01, and the task closes.
  • 结果RESULT两条 Issue 自动 Resolved：Open → In Progress → Resolved。Both Issues resolve automatically: Open → In Progress → Resolved.

货况调整、库存流水、页面版本和操作人全程可追溯。Condition, stock moves, page version and operator all traceable.

讨论DiscussionISS 哪一类异常也是“发现 → 集中处理 → 派工执行”？货况调整这类动作在 ISS 是否必须先人工确认？Which ISS exceptions also follow discover → triage → dispatch? Must actions like a condition change be human-confirmed first at ISS?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.2
013 · MD §D1.2.2.3 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.3DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.3

实施过程：让 Agent 懂 WMS，只用标准积木搭应用Implementation: know WMS, build only from standard blocks

直接让 AI 写页面，常见的四个问题是：字段对不上、每个需求一张新表、绕过库存规则、生成即上线。做法是把这四件事都交给 WMS 已有的机制。AI-written pages fail four ways: wrong fields, a table per need, bypassed inventory rules, and shipping whatever is generated. We hand all four to existing WMS mechanisms.

01 · KNOW

懂业务Know the business

难点PROBLEM不懂 WMS 字段与接口，看着对、跑不通。Without WMS fields and APIs, it looks right but does not run.

做法APPROACHItem Ontology 描述对象、流程、规则与配置；按操作索引的接口目录和内部 Skill 告诉 Agent 该调哪个接口。目录里没有的操作不编造。Item Ontology describes objects, processes, rules and configuration; an operation-indexed API catalog and internal Skills tell the Agent which API to call. Nothing outside the catalog is invented.

02 · BLOCKS

用积木，不建表Blocks, not tables

难点PROBLEM每个需求建一张表，各自重写库存逻辑。Each need adds a table and rewrites inventory logic.

做法APPROACH通用三层存储（Context · Lines · Records）承载任务数据，无需建表；常用动作封装成标准步骤，如 Move Inventory 已含扫描、托管和库存流水。Shared three-layer storage (Context · Lines · Records) holds task data with no new tables; common actions become standard steps—Move Inventory already handles scanning, custody and stock transactions.

03 · READ

只读取数，本人权限Read-only, own access

难点PROBLEM页面直查多张表，越权或拖慢系统。Pages query many tables, overreach access or slow the system.

做法APPROACH页面数据由只读 View 汇总现有接口，在隔离沙箱中运行，只拿当前用户的只读令牌；起草前先用真实数据预览。Page data comes from a read-only View that combines existing APIs, runs in an isolated sandbox with only the user's read-only token, and is previewed on real data before drafting.

04 · RELEASE

先试后发Try, then release

难点PROBLEM生成即上线，出了错难回退。Generated means live, and mistakes are hard to undo.

做法APPROACH草稿 → 试运行 → 修改 → 保存为任务类型并发布；测试环境导出定制包，生产导入为草稿，审批后发布。Draft → trial → revise → save as a task type and publish; export a package from test, import to production as a draft, publish after approval.

以上机制已在 ITEM WMS 本地环境实现；在 ISS 系统中能否成立，需逐项验证。These mechanisms exist in the ITEM WMS local environment; each must be verified in ISS systems.

讨论DiscussionISS 现有系统能否提供业务本体和按操作索引的接口目录？缺少时先缩小为只读看板，还是转交 DT 补齐？Can ISS systems provide a business ontology and an operation-indexed API catalog? If not, narrow to read-only dashboards first, or hand off to DT?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.3
014 · MD §D1.2.2.4 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.4DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.4

组织与价值证据：需求方直面 Agent，权限与证据由 WMS 守住Organisation and evidence: requesters work with the Agent directly; WMS guards access

职责可能从“提需求、等上线”变成“说需求、试用、确认”；但 Agent 能做的不超过用户本人，收益结论仍要改造前基线和同口径周期。Roles may shift from “request and wait” to “describe, try, confirm”, but the Agent can do no more than the user, and value claims still need a baseline and a like-for-like period.

职责可能怎样变化（建议）How roles may change (proposed)

角色Role改造前Before演示中In the demo
现场员工Floor staff提需求、等排期Request, wait对 Agent 说需求，试用、确认Tell the Agent, try, confirm
主管Supervisor等 IT 开发Wait for IT让 Agent 做工作台，自己发布、派工Has the Agent build it, publishes, dispatches
FDE / IT逐个开发页面Build each page维护本体、接口目录与标准步骤，补缺失接口Maintain ontology, API catalog and steps; handle missing APIs
Agent—理解、起草、修改；不超过用户本人权限Understand, draft, revise within the user's access

R5 共建：ISS Biz (team) 为业务 Owner 与验收；COO AI Team 与 ITEM 共同开发；DT 按需支撑。R5 co-build: ISS Biz (team) owns business and acceptance; COO AI Team and ITEM co-develop; DT supports as needed.

证据：机制已有，收益待测Evidence: mechanisms exist, value pending

  • 权限ACCESSAgent 用用户委托的 WMS 令牌；角色无权限、任务未指派给本人，一律 403。The Agent uses the user's delegated WMS token; no role permission or a task not assigned to the user means 403.
  • 留痕AUDIT每次写入进入数据变更日志，并记录来自哪个页面的哪个版本。Every write lands in the data change log with the originating page and version.
  • 业务BUSINESSIssue 状态时间线、货况调整、取货/放货库存流水均可追溯。Issue timeline, condition change and take/place stock transactions are traceable.

待测：需求到首个可用版本的时长、迭代轮次、试运行缺陷、回退次数与采用率；当前没有可引用的生产 KPI，不得写成已实现。To measure: time from need to first usable version, iterations, trial defects, rollbacks and adoption; no citable production KPI exists yet.

讨论DiscussionISS 由谁发布页面和任务类型、谁授权回退？基线由谁取、观察多久？Who publishes pages and task types at ISS, and who authorises rollback? Who owns the baseline, and for how long?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.4
015 · MD §D1.2.2.5 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.5DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.5

ISS 对标：要做到“现场说出来就能用”，ISS 还缺什么ISS benchmark: what ISS still lacks for “say it, use it”

前提有四个：Agent 懂 ISS 的业务和接口、能以本人权限调用、写入可追溯、发布受控。对标不是宣布 ISS 已具备，而是把缺口变成会中能回答的问题。Four prerequisites: the Agent knows ISS business and APIs, calls with the user's own access, writes are traceable, and release is controlled. Benchmarking does not claim ISS has them; it turns gaps into questions the room can answer.

差距地图Gap map

维度Dimension先确认什么First confirm
本体与接口Ontology and APIs对象、流程、规则是否成文；接口能否按操作检索Are objects, processes and rules written down; can APIs be found by operation
身份与权限Identity and access能否以用户本人令牌调用；角色、仓库与任务归属可判Can calls use the user's own token; are role, site and task ownership enforceable
数据与审计Data and audit写入是否带操作人、来源页面与版本Do writes carry operator, source page and version
发布治理Release governance测试/生产隔离、定制包导入、审批与回退Test/production separation, package import, approval and rollback

会中直接提问并确认Ask and confirm in the room

  • Q1 哪个 ISS 现场需求像“巡检 → 集中处理 → 派工”，且能在测试环境验证？Which ISS floor need resembles patrol → triage → dispatch and can be validated in test?
  • Q2 哪些操作已有接口，哪些只能先做只读看板？Which operations already have APIs, and which can only start as read-only dashboards?
  • Q3 哪些动作必须人确认：发布、库存/货况调整、派工？Which actions need human confirmation: publish, stock or condition change, dispatch?
  • Q4 谁发布、谁审批定制包导入、谁授权回退旧版本？Who publishes, who approves package import, who authorises rollback?

每个问题当场记下 Owner、涉及的系统/环境和证据位置。For each question, record the Owner, system/environment and evidence location on the spot.

讨论Discussion如果 ISS 系统缺少可用接口或本体，是先做只读 View 看板，还是转交 DT 补接口？If ISS systems lack usable APIs or an ontology, start with a read-only View dashboard, or hand off to DT to add APIs?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.5
016 · MD §D1.2.2.6 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.6DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.6

思考：需求一直在变——改动走版本发布，积木越攒越多Reflection: needs keep changing—version every change, grow the blocks

动态表单不是一次性生成物：改一次就是一个新版本；能长期留下、带到下一个场景的，是本体、标准积木和受控发布机制。A dynamic form is not a one-off: every change is a new version, and what lasts and carries to the next scene is the ontology, the standard blocks and controlled release.

01 · CHANGE CHAIN

业务变更链Change chain

  • 现场提出修改 → Agent 改草稿 → 试运行验证Floor asks for a change → Agent edits the draft → trial run
  • 有权限的人发布新版本；进行中的任务保留已录结果，从新版本继续An authorised person publishes; in-progress tasks keep what is recorded and continue on the new version
  • 每个版本保留，可停用，也能从旧版本重新发布Every version is kept, can be deactivated or republished

生成成功不等于上线，发布始终是人的决定。Generated is not released; release is always a human decision.

02 · ASSETS

可沉淀资产Reusable assets

  • 懂业务：Item Ontology、接口目录、内部 SkillKnow-how: Item Ontology, API catalog, internal Skills
  • 标准步骤：Move Inventory 等，随系统持续扩充Standard steps: Move Inventory and more over time
  • 应用：任务类型、Dynamic Page、View、Custom Object 类型，可打包导入Apps: task types, Dynamic Pages, Views, Custom Object types, packaged for import
03 · REUSE

第二场景：复用与重验证Second scene: reuse and revalidate

  • 复用：Move Inventory 同样用于组装、补货、库位优化、坏货处理。Reuse: Move Inventory also serves assembly, replenishment, slotting and damage handling.
  • 重验：货况与上架映射、角色权限、客户数据语义、接口副作用。Revalidate: condition and putaway mapping, roles, customer data meaning, API side effects.
  • 一个任务类型通过，不推断所有场景通过。One passing task type does not prove every scenario.
讨论DiscussionISS 哪些操作值得先抽象为 composable step？哪些规则必须在每个新仓库或新客户上重验？Which ISS operations are worth abstracting into composable steps first? Which rules must be revalidated for each new site or customer?

017 · MD §D1.2.2.7 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.7DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.7

可重复交付＋动手：现场说一个改动，走完草稿到发布Repeatable delivery + hands-on: state one change live, take it from draft to release

不追求现场产品化：用一个低风险改动，检验对话修改、试运行、发布和回退是否完整，并保留停止与转交路径。No forced productisation: one low-risk change checks that chat revision, trial, release and rollback are complete, with stop and handoff paths.

通用交付流程Repeatable flow

  • 说出需求 → Agent 查本体与接口 → 确认计划卡或草稿State the need → Agent checks ontology and APIs → approve the plan card or draft
  • 生成 Task / Page / View → 用真实数据试运行 → 修改Generate Task / Page / View → trial on real data → revise
  • 有权限的人发布 → 导出定制包 → 生产导入为草稿、审批、发布Authorised publish → export package → import to production as draft, approve, publish
TASK TYPE步骤与三层数据结构Steps and three-layer data
DYNAMIC PAGE页面、View、所需权限Page, View, required access
PACKAGE可导入的定制包Importable package
EVIDENCE版本、变更日志、库存流水Versions, change log, stock transactions

现场修改一个低风险规则Change one low-risk rule live

  • 对 Agent 说：“巡检上报加一个必选的破损原因”，或“放货前必须拍照”。Tell the Agent: “add a required damage reason to the patrol report”, or “require a photo before placing”.
  • 测试环境试运行后发布 v2；发布预览列出将跟随新版本的进行中任务。Trial in test, then publish v2; the preview lists in-progress tasks that will follow.
  • 失败时：留在草稿不发布；已发布可停用或从旧版本重新发布；接口缺失转 FDE/DT。On failure: stay in draft; deactivate or republish an older version; missing APIs go to FDE/DT.

待补：ISS 场景选择、参与人、试运行结果、目标环境与维护 Owner。To add: ISS scenario, participants, trial result, target environment and maintenance Owner.

ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.7
018 · MD §D1.2.3.1 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.1 · UNIS Rate & QuoteDAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.1 · UNIS Rate & Quote

先把业务痛点拍清，再定义要验证的结果Make the pain visible before defining the result to validate

业务说费率、报价与运输条件；开发看到系统、表格与字段。第一步不是宣称收益，而是对齐语义、交接与授权边界。Business speaks in rates, quotes and transport conditions; development sees systems, tables and fields. First align semantics, handoffs and access—not claimed benefits.

改造前：反复解释，定义可能分叉Before: repeated explanation, diverging definitions

业务需求Business need

客户、服务、运输、费率、报价、条件。Customer, service, transport, rate, quote, conditions.

→

系统与字段Systems and fields

不同系统、表格、状态和计算实现。Different systems, tables, states and calculations.

具体系统、交接人、审批节点、耗时和失败点：待 ISS Biz (team) 补证。Specific systems, handoffs, approval nodes, effort and failure points: ISS Biz (team) to provide.

期望结果＋预录视频位置Target result + pre-recorded video slot

  • 授权数据提出候选，业务专家确认语义。
  • 分析页面与应用表单共用同一本体。
  • 缺失条件、异常报价交给人；建议与正式报价分开授权。
  • Authorised data proposes candidates; business experts confirm meaning.
  • Analysis page and application form share one ontology.
  • Missing conditions and exceptions go to people; suggestion and formal quote stay separately authorised.
预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录：真实数据（已授权）→候选→专家审核→页面→表单→规则同步→人工接管。请标注真实 / 脱敏 / 模拟。Record: authorised data → candidates → expert review → page → form → rule sync → human handoff. Label real / redacted / simulated.

019 · MD §D1.2.3.2 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.2 · 闭环建议DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.2 · Proposed closed loop

同一本体贯穿建议、接管与状态回写One ontology links recommendation, takeover and state write-back

正常任务可走页面与表单；缺失信息、规则冲突和异常报价必须显式停下并交给人。Normal work can use the page and form; missing data, rule conflicts and abnormal quotes must stop visibly and go to a person.

正常任务Normal task

  • 输入客户、服务、运输条件、费率、报价条件、有效期。
  • 分析页面展示口径、条件影响、来源与缺失信息。
  • 表单做字段校验并生成报价建议。
  • Enter customer, service, transport conditions, rate, quote conditions and validity.
  • Analysis shows definition, condition impact, source and missing data.
  • The form validates fields and produces a quote suggestion.

缺失与异常Missing data and exceptions

  • 必需条件缺失：标缺口，停止自动推进。
  • 规则冲突、超期、计算差异：保留输入与规则版本。
  • 无法解释的异常报价：进入人工判断。
  • Required data missing: flag the gap and stop automatic progress.
  • Rule conflict, expiry or calculation difference: retain input and rule versions.
  • Unexplainable abnormal quote: route to human judgement.

确认、回写与结果Confirm, write back and result

HUMAN GATE专家确认语义与例外；授权人员确认建议；正式报价按既定审批。Experts confirm meaning and exceptions; authorised staff confirm suggestions; formal quotes follow existing approval.
STATE建议状态：草稿／待补信息／待审核／待授权／已确认／退回或停止。Suggested states: draft / missing data / review / authorisation / confirmed / returned or stopped.
WRITE-BACK使用与业务结果反向更新本体与规则；目标系统与结果定义待补。Usage and business results feed back to ontology and rules; target system and result definition are pending.
讨论焦点Discussion哪些状态已经存在？哪条边界必须阻止自动推进？正式报价由谁授权？Which states already exist? Which boundary must stop automation? Who authorises a formal quote?

020 · MD §D1.2.3.3 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.3 · 实施过程与采用DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.3 · Build, adoption and iteration

从授权数据到可回放的小范围验证From authorised data to a replayable bounded validation

先锁定边界和证据，再建设页面与表单；未知阻力标成可能困难，不写成历史事实。Lock scope and evidence before building pages and forms; possible difficulties are hypotheses, not historical facts.

01 · INPUT

输入与候选Inputs and candidates

  • 授权真实数据、字段说明、现有报价材料。
  • 识别对象、字段、关联、状态与来源版本。
  • Authorised data, field notes and quote material.
  • Identify objects, fields, relations, states and source version.
02 · REVIEW

专家审核Expert review

  • 确认条件、有效期、例外、计算与决策边界。
  • 记录确认人、版本、生效范围。
  • Confirm conditions, validity, exceptions, calculation and decision boundaries.
  • Record reviewer, version and effective scope.
03 · BUILD

页面与表单Page and form

  • 同一本体生成分析页面、字段校验和受控 Action。
  • 正常、缺失、冲突、异常样本回放。
  • Generate analysis, validation and controlled Actions from one ontology.
  • Replay normal, missing, conflicting and abnormal samples.
04 · ADOPT

采用与迭代Adopt and iterate

  • 业务专家和一线使用者用受控真实样本验收。
  • 按反馈补条件、异常、样本；必要时缩小或停止。
  • Experts and frontline users accept with controlled real samples.
  • Add conditions, exceptions and samples; narrow or stop when needed.

可能困难（待验证）Possible difficulties (to verify)

字段缺少业务语义、来源口径不一致、例外未覆盖、页面与表单定义分叉、权限或接口不清晰。Missing business meaning, inconsistent sources, uncovered exceptions, diverging page/form definitions, unclear access or interfaces.

建议机制：候选/确认分层、异常集、版本溯源、规则回归、正式报价权限门。Suggested controls: candidate/confirmed layers, exception set, version trace, rule regression and formal-quote gate.

讨论焦点Discussion首个小范围的输入、审核人和可回放样本由谁锁定？Who locks the first bounded scope’s inputs, reviewers and replayable samples?

021 · MD §D1.2.3.4 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.4 · 组织与价值证据DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.4 · Roles and value evidence

把职责和证据先写清，不虚构 KPIWrite ownership and evidence first; do not invent KPIs

组织分工是建议设计；验收要有分母、周期、错误级别和可回放证据。当前没有已实现运营结果。Roles are a proposed design; acceptance needs denominators, periods, error levels and replayable evidence. No achieved operating result is available here.

建议职责边界Suggested ownership

参与方Party职责Role
ISS Biz (team)场景、规则、数据定义、专家确认、验收与价值验证。Scenario, rules, data definition, expert review, acceptance and value.
ITEM与 COO AI Team/Hollis 紧密共同开发；实现页面、表单、测试和交付。Co-build closely with COO AI Team/Hollis; implement pages, forms, tests and delivery.
COO AI Team / DT已有成果与方法支撑；数据、代码、软件、接口等按需支撑。Existing results and method support; data, code, software and interfaces as needed.

审批、运营维护和正式报价 Owner：待确认。Approval, operations and formal-quote Owner: to be confirmed.

验收基线与待补结果Acceptance baseline and missing results

  • 分母：预先锁定的样本集与业务边界。
  • 周期：约定回放/运营周期。
  • 观察：概念一致、必填完整、来源可追溯、计算差异、异常升级、接管记录、页面/表单一致。
  • 错误级别：语义、规则/计算、权限/流程、数据质量、结果记录。
  • Denominator: locked sample set and business boundary.
  • Period: agreed replay/operations period.
  • Observe: semantic consistency, completeness, traceability, calculation gaps, escalation, takeover and page/form alignment.
  • Error levels: semantic, rule/calculation, access/process, data quality and result-record errors.

待补证据Evidence needed

样本量、基线、各类错误数、人工时长/成本、接管率、回滚次数、正式报价通过/退回情况。Sample size, baseline, error counts, effort/cost, takeover rate, rollbacks and formal-quote approvals/returns.

讨论焦点Discussion谁是业务 Owner、专家审核人、验收人和运营维护人？首轮分母与周期是什么？Who are the business Owner, expert reviewer, acceptance owner and operations owner? What are the first denominator and period?

022 · MD §D1.2.3.5 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.5 · ISS 对标DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.5 · ISS benchmark

对标差距要落到具体问题与 OwnerBenchmark gaps must land on questions and Owners

已知现状是业务与开发围绕报价、费率和条件反复沟通；其余系统、权限、接口与运营事实需在会中填写。Known today: business and development repeatedly align on rates, quotes and conditions. Systems, access, interfaces and operations must be filled in live.

对标四个差距面Four gap surfaces

KNOWLEDGE字段、规则、例外、有效期与计算含义是否有审核记录？Are meanings of fields, rules, exceptions, validity and calculation reviewed?
DATA授权样本、来源版本、质量与脱敏方式是什么？What are the authorised samples, source version, quality and redaction?
INTERFACE分析页面、表单、状态回写和正式报价权限在哪里？Where are the analysis page, form, state write-back and formal-quote access?
OPERATIONS谁接管异常、审批、回滚、维护和结果复盘？Who takes exceptions, approves, rolls back, maintains and reviews results?

现场填写与迁移边界Live capture and transfer boundary

  • 最小可复现报价样本：`[ISS Biz (team) 填写]`
  • 歧义字段与业务专家：`[ISS Biz (team) 填写]`
  • 系统/接口/权限 Owner：`[ISS Biz (team)/DT 填写]`
  • 最佳实践可迁移证据：`[COO AI Team/ITEM/ISS Biz 填写]`
  • Minimum replayable quote sample: `[ISS Biz (team) fill]`
  • Ambiguous fields and expert: `[ISS Biz (team) fill]`
  • System/interface/access Owner: `[ISS Biz (team)/DT fill]`
  • Transfer evidence: `[COO AI Team/ITEM/ISS Biz fill]`

相关材料边界Material boundary

PEI、UKM 是后续候选；BNP → 动态表单 → PEI 仅作补充材料，不与本次 UNIS 项目混同。PEI and UKM are later candidates; BNP → dynamic form → PEI is supplementary, not the same UNIS project.

讨论焦点Discussion今天能锁定哪一个差距、证据、Owner 和截止时间？Which gap, evidence, Owner and due date can we lock today?

023 · MD §D1.2.3.6 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.6 · 变更链与知识沉淀DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.6 · Change chain and knowledge

规则变化必须走审核、回归、发布与回滚Rule changes need review, regression, release and rollback

把业务知识沉淀为可授权、可审核、可回放的资产；第二场景复用机制，不复用未经验证的语义。Turn business knowledge into authorised, reviewable and replayable assets; reuse mechanisms, not unverified semantics.

业务变更链Business change chain

01 · BUSINESS业务提出费率、报价条件或例外变更。Business proposes a rate, quote-condition or exception change.
02 · EXPERT专家审核含义、边界、生效范围。Expert reviews meaning, boundaries and effective scope.
03 · FDE / ITEM修改本体、规则、页面或表单。FDE / ITEM changes ontology, rule, page or form.
04 · GATE回归 → 业务验收 → 按权限发布或回滚 → 运营回写。Regression → business acceptance → authorised release or rollback → operations write-back.

可沉淀与需重验证Reuse versus re-validate

  • 可沉淀：审核定义、异常样本、版本溯源、字段校验、权限门、评测集、回滚和运营机制。
  • 需重验证：客户/服务/运输/费率语义、接口、权限、计算条件、例外和正式报价边界。
  • 第二场景：不因都使用本体就视为同一应用。
  • Reuse: reviewed definitions, exception samples, traceability, validation, access gates, evals, rollback and operations.
  • Re-validate: customer/service/transport/rate semantics, interfaces, access, calculations, exceptions and formal-quote boundary.
  • Second scene: ontology use alone does not make one application.

具体工具、系统和知识库位置：待补。Specific tools, systems and knowledge-base location: pending.

讨论焦点Discussion谁可以提出变更？谁审核？回归样本和回滚门在哪里？Who may propose a change? Who reviews it? Where are regression samples and rollback gates?

024 · MD §D1.2.3.7 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.7 · 可重复交付与动手DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.7 · Repeatable delivery and hands-on

现场把一条规则改完，并留下可验收草稿Change one rule live and leave an acceptance-ready draft

通用方法可以复用，业务语义必须重验证；动手目标是小范围草稿，不是宣称上线或正式报价成功。The method can repeat, but business semantics must be re-validated. The hands-on output is a bounded draft, not a production or formal-quote claim.

可重复交付链Repeatable delivery chain

01 · SCOPE授权数据与边界Authorised data and scope
02 · MODEL候选 → 审核 → 本体/规则Candidate → review → ontology/rule
03 · BUILD页面 → 表单 → 校验Page → form → validation
04 · PROVE正常/异常回放 → 人确认Normal/exception replay → human confirmation
05 · OPERATE验收 → 发布/回滚 → 反馈Acceptance → release/rollback → feedback

通用核心：审核、版本、溯源、异常分流、权限门、评测与维护。Common core: review, versioning, traceability, exception routing, access gates, evaluation and maintenance.

现场动手与停止机制Hands-on and stop rules

  • ISS Biz (team) 提供一条已授权、可脱敏的最小报价样本。
  • 修改一条业务规则/报价条件，展示本体定义、分析口径、表单校验、异常路径和权限门。
  • 产出：能力卡、小范围验收表、责任字段草稿。
  • 语义无法确认、样本不足、接口/权限不清或无法安全接管：缩小、转人工、暂停或停止。
  • ISS Biz (team) provides one authorised, redacted minimum quote sample.
  • Change one rule/quote condition; show ontology, analysis definition, form validation, exception path and access gate.
  • Output: capability card, bounded acceptance sheet and ownership fields.
  • If meaning, samples, interfaces, access or safe takeover fail: narrow, hand off, pause or stop.
讨论焦点Discussion今天能带来哪条授权样本和哪条规则？谁签收草稿，什么条件下停止？Which authorised sample and rule can we bring today? Who signs the draft, and when do we stop?

025 · MD §D1.2.4.1 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.1

ISS BO：从“订单在哪里”到“下一步怎么做”ISS BO: From “where is the order?” to “what happens next?”

先锁定一条可验收的 BO / Customer Promise 链，再把规则、交接和证据放进同一个闭环。Start with one testable BO / Customer Promise chain, then connect rules, handoffs, and evidence in one loop.

业务痛点与期望结果Pain and intended outcome

  • 规则随业务线、地区、服务承诺、料件、库存、物流状态变化；单一 Prompt 难以覆盖合理例外。Rules vary by line, region, promise, part, inventory, and logistics; one prompt cannot cover valid exceptions.
  • 建议结果：解释为什么延迟、什么时候完成、下一步怎么做，并保留证据与人工边界。Intended outcome: explain delay, estimate completion, and propose next action with evidence and human boundaries.

改造前待核实：查WIKI → 跨系统核对 → 专家判断 → 客户承诺 → 人工回写。标出重复查询、交接与延迟。Before, to verify: WIKI lookup → cross-system checks → expert judgment → customer promise → manual write-back. Identify repeated checks and handoffs.

范围建议：先选择有限业务线、地区、料件与服务承诺组合；不把全组织覆盖写成已完成。Scope: choose limited lines, regions, parts and promises; enterprise-wide coverage is not claimed.

预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：一条 BO / Customer Promise 链，从 WIKI 规则、跨系统查询、ETA/风险判断到专家确认与状态回写。Suggested recording: one BO / Customer Promise chain, from a WIKI rule and cross-system query through ETA/risk review, expert confirmation, and status write-back.

请区分：真实业务、脱敏演示、模拟流程；本槽位不含 src，不代表已有结果。Label it as real, anonymized, or simulated; this slot has no src and does not imply an achieved result.

讨论Discussion本轮先覆盖哪些规则？当前流程中最慢的交接在哪里？Which rules come first, and where is the slowest handoff today?

026 · MD §D1.2.4.2 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.2

改造后闭环：回答、判断、接管、回写Future loop: answer, decide, hand over, write back

建议把“可回答”与“可执行”拆开：先给出可追溯判断，再按风险和权限决定是否放行。Separate “answerable” from “executable”: give a traceable judgment first, then gate action by risk and authority.

01 · 建议路径01 · Suggested path

正常任务Normal task

  • 读取订单、料件、库存、替代件、物流与 ETA 信息。Read order, part, inventory, substitute, logistics, and ETA data.
  • 输出延迟原因、预计完成时间、候选方案与下一步 Action。Return delay reason, ETA, options, and next Action.
  • 保留知识/规则版本与证据来源。Keep knowledge/rule version and evidence sources.
02 · 建议路径02 · Suggested path

缺失信息与异常Missing data and exceptions

  • 字段缺失、规则冲突、超范围或高风险时，返回缺口与待确认项，不猜测。For missing fields, conflicts, out-of-scope, or high risk, return gaps and questions; do not guess.
  • 进入人工队列，标记失败类型与影响范围。Route to a human queue with failure type and impact.
  • 复杂预测/优化仅按实际可接入范围调用。Use advanced prediction/optimization only where actually connected.
03 · 人确认＋状态回写03 · Human approval + write-back

放行边界Release boundary

  • ISS Biz 专家确认规则、结果与可接受动作。ISS Biz experts confirm rules, results, and acceptable actions.
  • 确认后回写结果、证据、版本、审批人与执行状态。After approval, write back result, evidence, version, approver, and execution status.
  • 失败/超时回人工；不把完整跨组织接通写成已完成。On failure/timeout, return to humans; do not claim full cross-organization integration.
讨论Discussion哪类 Action 必须审批？哪些状态字段需要保留审计记录？Which Actions require approval, and which status fields need an audit trail?

027 · MD §D1.2.4.3 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.3

实施不是“接一个模型”：FDE 把知识变成可运行闭环Implementation is more than calling a model: FDE makes knowledge runnable

按版本、样本、专家审核和独立评测推进；困难先作为风险管理，不把未证实阻力写成历史事实。Work through versions, samples, expert review, and independent evaluation; treat unverified obstacles as risks, not history.

建议实施链Suggested build chain

  1. 从 WIKI/已有知识确定范围、主要规则与当前版本。Set scope, key rules, and current version from WIKI and existing knowledge.
  2. 建立小本体，补齐正常、例外、缺失和边界样本。Build a small ontology and add normal, exception, missing, and boundary samples.
  3. 专家确认规则、结果和可接受动作。Experts confirm rules, results, and acceptable actions.
  4. 独立评测拆分回答、规则判断、预测、建议和 Action。Independently evaluate answers, rule judgments, forecasts, recommendations, and Actions.

可能困难与克服机制Possible difficulties and countermeasures

  • 术语/版本不一致 → 版本化词表与审核记录。Term/version inconsistency → versioned glossary and review log.
  • 字段缺失或例外难枚举 → 字段契约、分层样本与风险分级。Missing fields or hard-to-enumerate exceptions → field contract, stratified samples, risk tiers.
  • 专家时间有限 → 短时审核、待确认队列与截止时间。Limited expert time → short reviews, a question queue, and deadlines.
  • 调试样本混入评测集 → 训练/调试与独立评测严格分开。Debug samples leaking into evaluation → strict separation.

采用建议：现场演示一条可追踪链，让专家先改一个规则或边界样本，再形成责任人和回归项。Adoption suggestion: demo one traceable chain; let an expert change one rule or boundary sample, then assign an owner and regression item.

讨论Discussion哪一类错误应返回知识、规则、样本、本体、接口，还是运营流程？Which errors should go back to knowledge, rules, samples, ontology, interfaces, or operations?

028 · MD §D1.2.4.4 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.4

组织与价值证据：把 90% 放回正确分母Organization and value evidence: put 90% on the right denominator

职责可以先建议，结果必须后验收；回答、规则判断、ETA、建议与 Action 分开报告。Responsibilities can be proposed; results must be evidenced. Report answers, rule judgments, ETA, recommendations, and Actions separately.

责任与运营Responsibilities and operations

  • Tom 主持；ITEM 对接 COO AI Team / Hollis；ISS Biz (team) 负责业务规则与验收；DT 按需支撑数据、代码、软件、接口和跨部门。Tom facilitates; ITEM connects COO AI Team / Hollis; ISS Biz (team) owns rules and acceptance; DT supports data, code, software, interfaces, and cross-team work as needed.
  • FDE 连接知识、例外、样本、系统能力与可运行应用，不替代业务 Owner。FDE connects knowledge, exceptions, samples, systems, and runnable applications; it does not replace the business Owner.
  • 建议明确本体、样本、评测、发布、回滚与异常队列的维护人。Assign maintainers for ontology, samples, evaluation, release, rollback, and exception queues.

验收与 90%口径Acceptance and the 90% metric

  • 绑定任务、场景、版本、样本来源、专家口径与失败分布。Bind it to task, scenario, version, sample source, expert rubric, and failure distribution.
  • 尚无完整评测时，只标为验证目标，不写成整体上线结果。If evaluation is incomplete, label it a target, not an overall production result.
  • 高风险错误单列；权限、风险和人工确认决定能否执行。Report high-risk errors separately; authority, risk, and human approval gate execution.
  • 训练/调试样本与独立评测集分开；合成样本标注来源。Separate training/debug samples from independent evaluation; label synthetic sources.

待补：正确案例数/有效评测案例数、周期、基线、成本、人工介入与错误等级。To fill: correct/valid cases, period, baseline, cost, human intervention, and error levels.

讨论Discussion90%具体衡量什么？高风险错误的放行阈值和 Owner 是谁？What exactly does 90% measure? Who owns the release threshold for high-risk errors?

029 · MD §D1.2.4.5 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.5

ISS 对标：把未知差距变成会中可填的问题ISS benchmark: turn unknown gaps into questions to fill live

已知方法主线是 WIKI → 小本体 → 样本＋专家审核 → 评测 → 泛化；现状、接口和运营数据仍需现场确认。The known method is WIKI → small ontology → samples plus expert review → evaluation → generalization; current gaps need live confirmation.

对标基线Benchmark baseline

现状Current规则分散于 WIKI、专家判断与跨系统查询；具体节点、周期未知。Rules span WIKI, expert judgment, and cross-system queries; nodes and cycle time unknown.
最好实践Best practice小范围本体与独立评测，错误返回知识/规则/样本/本体。Small-scope ontology and independent evaluation; route errors back to knowledge/rules/samples/ontology.
知识/数据Knowledge/data必要概念已列；字段、版本、来源与样本分布未知。Core concepts are listed; fields, versions, sources, and sample mix unknown.
接口/组织Interfaces/org需要按权限查询并回写；实际系统、Owner、审批链未知。Permissioned query and write-back are needed; systems, owners, and approval chain unknown.

会中具体追问Questions to answer live

  1. 当前端到端流程、平均周期、重复查询和交接点是什么？What are the end-to-end flow, average cycle, repeat queries, and handoffs?
  2. 哪一条 ISS 最好实践可复用？哪一条必须重验证？Which ISS best practice can be reused, and which needs revalidation?
  3. 哪些字段可读/可写？哪些 Action 必须人工审批？Which fields are readable/writable, and which Actions need human approval?
  4. 谁维护本体、样本、评测、发布、回滚和异常队列？Who maintains ontology, samples, evaluation, release, rollback, and exception queues?
会中待确认：业务线｜系统｜Owner｜周期｜差距Confirm live: line | systems | Owner | cycle | gap
讨论Discussion哪个差距会阻止本轮验收？先缩小范围还是先补接口？Which gap blocks acceptance: narrow scope first, or close the interface gap first?

030 · MD §D1.2.4.6 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.6

思考：业务变更链，才是可持续泛化的边界Reflection: the change chain defines sustainable generalization

复用的是治理与交付方法，不是把一个小本体的结果直接外推到全部 BO。Reuse the delivery and governance method, not the result of one small ontology across all BO.

建议变更链Suggested change chain

  1. 业务提出规则/服务承诺变化Business proposes a rule or service-promise change
  2. ISS Biz 专家审核授权ISS Biz expert reviews and authorizes
  3. FDE 修改知识、本体、规则与样本FDE changes knowledge, ontology, rules, and samples
  4. 独立回归评测，复核风险与权限Independent regression; recheck risk and authority
  5. 发布；失败则回滚或转人工Release; roll back or hand over if it fails

可沉淀与必须重验证What to retain and revalidate

  • 可沉淀：授权术语、规则与例外、流程、Skill、评测集、错误分类、运营 SLA、审计字段、发布/回滚机制。Retain: authorized terms, rules, exceptions, processes, Skills, evaluation sets, error taxonomy, SLAs, audit fields, release/rollback.
  • 第二场景复用：本体骨架、样本分层、专家模板、评测拆分、风险分级、责任矩阵。Reuse: ontology skeleton, sample stratification, expert template, evaluation split, risk tiers, responsibility matrix.
  • 必须重验证：术语、服务承诺、地区规则、料件/库存/物流字段、接口权限、样本分布、高风险动作。Revalidate: terms, promises, regional rules, part/inventory/logistics fields, interface authority, sample mix, high-risk Actions.
记录：每次变更保留版本、样本来源、评测结果、审批人与生效范围。Record: version, sample source, evaluation result, approver, and effective scope for every change.
讨论Discussion谁有权授权知识进入核心库？第二场景最需要重验证哪一项？Who authorizes knowledge into the core library? What needs the strongest revalidation in scenario two?

031 · MD §D1.2.4.7 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.7

可重复交付＋动手：从一条规则产出能力卡Repeatable delivery + hands-on: turn one rule into a capability card

现场不追求一次产品化；完成一个小范围、可审计、可回滚的草稿，并明确下一步责任。Do not force productization today; produce a small, auditable, reversible draft with clear ownership.

可重复交付包Repeatable delivery package

  • 范围与术语卡；小本体与字段契约。Scope and glossary card; small ontology and field contract.
  • 正常/例外/缺失/边界样本包；专家审核记录。Normal/exception/missing/boundary samples; expert review log.
  • 独立评测集与任务口径；接口、权限、人工接管和状态回写说明。Independent evaluation and task definitions; interface, authority, handover, and write-back notes.
  • 运营看板、错误分级、发布/回滚和责任矩阵。Operations view, error tiers, release/rollback, and responsibility matrix.

现场动手与停止条件Hands-on and stop conditions

动作建议：用授权材料修改一个规则或流程；例如把“ETA 缺失”例外加入样本，写出人工接管、验收项、责任人和回滚点。Suggested action: modify one authorized rule or flow; for example, add an “ETA missing” exception with handover, acceptance, owner, and rollback point.

产出：小范围草稿＋能力卡＋验收表＋责任矩阵；记录版本、专家确认与评测影响。Output: small-scope draft, capability card, acceptance sheet, responsibility matrix; record version, expert approval, and evaluation impact.

失败机制：本体失效、字段不可得、独立评测不通过或高风险错误未关闭 → 缩小范围、暂停自动 Action、转 ISS Biz 专家/人工队列。Failure mechanism: ontology failure, unavailable fields, failed evaluation, or open high-risk errors → narrow scope, pause automatic Actions, and hand over to ISS Biz experts/humans.

讨论Discussion今天现场要修改哪条规则？谁签字验收，什么条件触发停止？Which rule will we change today? Who signs acceptance, and what triggers a stop?

为什么：做得出来、说不清楚Why: Work People Can Do but Cannot Easily Write Down

业务人员演示一遍，ItemGPT 学成可复用的技能，并整理成 SOP；适合 backlog 处理、物流数据采集、线下资料整理和跨系统操作。A business user demonstrates once; ItemGPT learns a reusable skill and writes the SOP. It fits backlog work, logistics data collection, offline paperwork and cross-system tasks.

痛点PAIN POINT我们的做法OUR APPROACH
写 SOP 门槛高，还常漏掉步骤和例外Writing SOPs is costly and misses steps照常做一遍，ItemGPT 整理成 SOPWork as usual once; ItemGPT writes the SOP
经验靠访谈和回忆，判断说不清Judgement is lost in interviews and recall从真实操作提取判断，标出不确定处Extract decisions from real work and flag doubts

033 · MD §D1.2.5.2 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.2DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.2

怎么实现（一）：采集与理解How It Works (1): Capture and Understand

录制由用户在对话里发起和结束；ItemGPT 以操作时间线为准、视频为补充，弄清每一步在做什么。The user starts and finishes the recording from the chat; ItemGPT reads the action timeline first and the video second to understand each step.

三种录制方式Three capture modes

  • 浏览器：扩展录标签页画面，并记录点击、输入和页面跳转。Browser: the extension records the tab plus clicks, typing and navigation.
  • 桌面：Companion 录屏幕，并记录桌面应用里的操作。Desktop: Companion records the screen plus actions in desktop apps.
  • 混合：两者同时，适合在网页和桌面软件之间来回切换的流程。Mixed: both at once, for flows that move between web and desktop apps.

理解流程Understand the flow

  • 以操作时间线为准，视频补充画面信息。The action timeline leads; the video fills in what was on screen.
  • 区分演示用的具体值（单号、收件人）和可复用的步骤，回放时不照搬旧值。Demo values such as order numbers and recipients are kept apart from reusable steps, so replays never reuse old values.

由用户发起和结束Started and finished by the user

在对话里说明要演示的任务 → 点开始 → 照常操作 → 点完成，录像和操作时间线上传到当前对话。Describe the task in chat → Start → work as usual → Finish; the video and the action timeline upload to the chat.

标出不确定，不靠猜Flag uncertainty instead of guessing

FMS 案例中，ItemGPT 指出演示时提交的是内部备注而不是客户回复，还录进了无关窗口；这些都写进技能，作为回放时的注意事项。In the FMS case, ItemGPT noticed that the demo posted an internal note rather than a customer reply, and that an unrelated window was recorded; both became cautions in the skill.

讨论DiscussionISS 的流程主要在网页里，还是也要用到 Excel、邮件等桌面软件？Do ISS flows stay in the browser, or also use desktop apps such as Excel and email?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.5.2
034 · MD §D1.2.5.3 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.3DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.3

怎么实现（二）：沉淀与执行How It Works (2): Learn and Run

一次演示得到两份产出：给 Agent 执行的技能和给人看的 SOP；回放时读当前页面再操作，不是机械重放。One demonstration yields two outputs: a skill the agent runs and an SOP people read. Replays read the current page instead of repeating clicks.

两份产出Two outputs

  • 技能：给 Agent 执行；默认仅本人可用，确认好用后可发布给同一租户的同事。Skill: run by the agent; private by default, and can be published to colleagues in the same tenant.
  • SOP：一句话生成，含适用场景、系统与权限、步骤与判断、异常和待确认事项。SOP: generated from one sentence, covering scope, systems and access, steps and decisions, exceptions and open points.

回放执行Replay

  • 新对话里用自然语言提需求，换新数据也能做，例如新的 Load No。Ask in plain language in a new chat; new inputs work, such as a new Load No.
  • 网页步骤由扩展执行，桌面应用和本地文件由 Companion 执行，两边可以交接。The extension runs web steps; Companion runs desktop apps and local files, and they hand work to each other.
  • 沿用用户自己的登录状态。It reuses the user's existing sign-ins.

核验与更新Verify and update

  • 完成后核验结果，例如邮件发出后到“已发送”核对收件人、主题和附件。It checks the result, for example recipient, subject and attachments in Sent mail.
  • 再演示同一个流程，会更新原来的技能，而不是新建一份。Demonstrating the same flow again updates the existing skill instead of adding a copy.
讨论Discussion一次执行要核验到什么程度，才算真正完成？What evidence shows that a run is really complete?

DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.4DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.4

人工确认、接管与合规Human Confirmation, Takeover and Compliance

ItemGPT 在用户自己的电脑上、以用户本人的权限运行；遇到登录或未授权的动作就交给人。ItemGPT runs on the user's own computer with the user's own permissions, and hands back to the user for sign-ins or unapproved actions.

什么时候交给人When it hands back

  • 需要登录或验证码：不代填密码，请用户在自己的浏览器里完成。Sign-in or CAPTCHA: it never enters passwords; the user completes it in their own browser.
  • 只让查找或起草：只存草稿，不擅自发送；无法唯一定位时先问人。Asked only to look up or draft: it saves a draft and never sends; it asks when a record is ambiguous.

合规Compliance

  • 录制由用户发起和结束；对外分享前脱敏。Users start and stop each recording; de-identify before sharing.
  • 原始视频和元数据默认 1 天后删除，可按业务需求设定；保留技能和 SOP。Raw video and metadata are deleted after 1 day by default, configurable per business need; skills and SOPs are kept.
  • 写入和发送按授权执行，每一步留在对话记录里。Writes and sends follow the user's authorization; every step stays in the chat record.

为什么在用户自己的电脑上运行Why run on the user's own computer

自己的电脑（扩展＋桌面端）OWN COMPUTER (EXTENSION + DESKTOP)云端无头浏览器HOSTED HEADLESS BROWSER
登录Sign-in沿用已有登录Reuses existing sign-ins每个系统重新登录Signs in to every system again
凭证Credentials密码不交给 ItemGPTPasswords stay with the user密码交给云端保存Passwords stored in the cloud
访问Access内网、VPN、白名单照常可用Intranet, VPN and allow-lists work常被 MFA、验证码、白名单拦住Often blocked by MFA, CAPTCHA or allow-lists
本机应用Local apps任意桌面应用和本地文件，读不到控件时按屏幕操作Any desktop app or file; screen control as fallback接触不到Out of reach
权限Control与本人一致，每步可见、随时可停Same as the user; every step visible and stoppable另开服务账号，后台运行Separate service account; runs unseen

036 · MD §D1.2.5.5 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.5DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.5

变更与复用Change and Reuse

规则变了，再演示一遍或在对话里说一句；技能可以发布给同事，各自用自己的权限执行。When a rule changes, demonstrate again or say it in chat. Skills can be shared with colleagues, who run them with their own permissions.

规则变了怎么办When a rule changes

再演示一遍，或在对话里直接说明新规则；ItemGPT 更新原来的技能，保留没有被推翻的内容。Demonstrate again, or state the new rule in chat; ItemGPT updates the existing skill and keeps what still holds.

例：“封条照片看不清就先问我，不要发。”Example: “If the seal photo is unreadable, ask me before sending.”

需要重新确认的What to recheck

换到新系统或新场景时，账号权限、页面结构和业务规则要重新演示或确认；录得下来不代表能直接照搬。For a new system or scenario, recheck access, page structure and business rules; being recordable does not mean it transfers as-is.

复用与共享Reuse and sharing

  • 技能可发布给同一租户的同事；同事在自己的浏览器里、用自己的登录和权限执行，不共用账号。Publish a skill to colleagues in the same tenant; each runs it in their own browser with their own sign-in and permissions, with no shared accounts.
  • 技能更新后，使用它的同事都会用到新版本；发布前建议由业务 Owner 审阅 SOP。Updates reach everyone using the skill, so a business owner should review the SOP before publishing.
  • SOP 可直接用于培训和交接；同一套方法可用于其他跨系统流程。SOPs serve training and handover; the same method applies to other cross-system flows.
讨论Discussion谁来审核和发布技能？更新后怎么通知使用的同事？Who reviews and publishes skills, and how are users told about updates?

现场演示（可选）与讨论Live Demo (Optional) and Discussion

视时间而定：现场录一遍 WMS 装车照片的流程，再换一个 Load No，让 ItemGPT 自己完成。Time permitting: record the WMS loading-photo flow live, then let ItemGPT handle a new Load No on its own.

演示流程Demo flow

  1. 场景：客户提供 Load No，要这票货的装车和封条照片。Scenario: a customer gives a Load No and asks for loading and seal photos.
  2. 录制（混合）：浏览器里在 WMS 找到 Load 和关联的 Load Task，打开 Photos；桌面上用 Mail 把照片发出。Record (mixed): in WMS, find the Load and its Load Task and open Photos; on the desktop, send the photos with Mail.
  3. 学习：ItemGPT 存成技能，并列出待确认事项。Learn: ItemGPT saves a skill and lists open points.
  4. 回放：新对话里换一个 Load No，一句话完成，并到“已发送”核对结果。Replay: in a new chat, one sentence with a new Load No; then check Sent mail.

可选：现场改规则Optional: change a rule live

在对话里加一条规则后重跑，展示技能如何更新。Add a rule in chat and rerun to show the skill updating.

时长参考Timing

录制约 2 分钟；学习约 5–7 分钟；回放约 3 分钟。Record about 2 min; learn about 5–7 min; replay about 3 min.

038 · MD §D1.2.6.1 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.1

Item CCS：把企业知识接入 Genesys 客服流程Item CCS: connecting enterprise knowledge to Genesys service

我们已经具备 Genesys Cloud 集成能力，让来电、IVA（Interactive Voice Agent）、路由和坐席工作可以被监测、理解、更新和验证。We have integrated with Genesys Cloud so calls, IVA (Interactive Voice Agent), routing and agent work can be monitored, understood, updated and verified.

我们已经做了什么What we have built

  • 监测客户来电和问题趋势，识别持续出现的客户需求，而不是把偶然波动当成趋势。Monitor call and issue trends to identify persistent demand rather than treating every fluctuation as a trend.
  • 从企业知识库和 SOP 中起草 IVA 或坐席辅助内容，并保留来源依据。Draft IVA or agent-assist content from enterprise knowledge and SOPs, with the supporting source.
  • 在发布前进行风险检查，由人工决定是否发布、暂停或回滚。Run risk checks before release; people decide whether to publish, pause or roll back.
  • 发布后自动拨测，检查语音流程是否能正常走完，并把结果回写。Run automated test calls after release and write the results back for follow-up.

Genesys 与 Item CCS 的分工How Genesys and Item CCS work together

  • Genesys 承载客户沟通、IVA、路由和坐席工作。Genesys handles customer communication, IVA, routing and agent work.
  • Item CCS 增加监测、知识、判断、发布和验证能力。Item CCS adds monitoring, knowledge, decision, release and validation capabilities.
  • 我们不是重新建设一个呼叫中心，而是让现有平台能够持续改进服务流程。We are not rebuilding a contact centre; we make the existing platform continuously improvable.
讨论Discussion这套能力以后如何接入客户自己的知识、系统和业务流程？How can this capability connect to a customer’s own knowledge, systems and processes?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.6.1
039 · MD §D1.2.6.2 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.2

从客户问题变化，到服务流程更新的闭环From changing demand to updated service flows

Item CCS 不是一次性改一个 IVA，而是把发现问题、形成内容、人工审核、Genesys 发布和结果验证连成一条闭环。Item CCS is not a one-off IVA change; it closes the loop from detecting demand to creating, approving, publishing and validating service content.

01

来电趋势Call trend

发现某类问题持续增加。Detect a sustained increase in a type of issue.

02

核实是真问题Verify the signal

过滤偶然波动、错误标签和人为改名。Filter one-off noise, bad labels and naming changes.

03

查找企业知识Find enterprise knowledge

从授权的知识库和 SOP 中找到依据。Find the supporting answer in authorised knowledge and SOPs.

04

起草服务内容Draft service content

形成 IVA、路由或坐席辅助的候选改动。Draft a candidate IVA, routing or agent-assist change.

05

人工审核Human approval

查看依据、影响范围和风险后决定。Review evidence, impact and risk before deciding.

06

Genesys 发布Publish in Genesys

受控发布，并保留版本和回滚点。Release under control with a version and rollback point.

07

自动拨测Test automatically

像真实客户一样拨打，检查流程是否走通。Call like a real customer and check that the flow works.

08

结果回写Write back

把结果用于下一轮改进，而不是停在演示。Use the result for the next improvement rather than stopping at a demo.

核心原则Core principle

  • 自动化的是流程，不是取消人工责任；人工始终掌握批准、发布和停止权。Automate the process, not human accountability; people retain approval, release and stop authority.
讨论Discussion问题出现后，哪些信息可以由系统准备，哪些决定必须由人确认？When an issue appears, what can the system prepare and what must a person confirm?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.6.2
040 · MD §D1.2.6.3 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.3

SOP 如何从真实操作中沉淀出来How SOPs emerge from real-world operations

专家可以直接写 SOP；经授权的录屏则补足真实操作中的隐性判断，也让团队能够比较不同专家处理同类问题的路径，找出更稳定、可复用的经验，最后仍由专家确认。Experts can write SOPs directly. Authorised recordings add tacit decisions from real operations and let teams compare how different experts handle the same problem, identify more stable and reusable practices, and leave final approval to experts.

从真实过程提炼可复用经验Extract reusable experience from real processes

  • 专家可以直接写 SOP；录屏的价值，是保留实际字段、操作顺序、系统切换、判断分支和最终结果。Experts can write SOPs directly; recordings preserve actual fields, action order, system switches, decision branches and final outcomes.
  • 把不同专家处理同类问题的路径放在一起比较，看处理结果、返工情况、稳定性和适用范围，识别更值得复用的经验。Compare different experts’ paths for the same problem by outcome, rework, stability and applicability to identify experience worth reusing.
  • 录屏只提供候选证据，看不到全部思考；专家补充判断依据、适用条件和例外，确认后才形成 SOP。Recordings provide candidate evidence, not the full reasoning; experts add rationale, applicability and exceptions before approving an SOP.

SOP 的产生路径How an SOP is produced

  • 真实操作记录 → 提取不同处理路径 → 比较结果与适用条件。Real operation records → extract different paths → compare outcomes and applicability.
  • 专家确认更优或更稳妥的做法，补齐“为什么这样做”和不能照搬的例外。Experts confirm the better or safer approach and add why it works and which exceptions cannot be copied.
  • 通过测试、版本化和回归验证后，才发布为可复用 SOP；不是系统自动决定谁的经验最好。Only after testing, versioning and regression does it become a reusable SOP; the system does not automatically rank whose experience is best.

录屏不是唯一来源：已有准确 SOP 直接复用；不能录制时采用访谈或演示。只有文档不足、流程复杂且需要保留真实过程时，才补充授权录屏。Recording is not the only source: reuse accurate SOPs; use interviews or demonstrations when recording is not permitted. Add authorised recordings only when documentation is insufficient, the work is complex and the real process needs to be preserved.

讨论Discussion我们需要的不是“监控员工”，而是获得经过授权的业务证据；下一页说明这些证据如何安全脱敏。We need authorised business evidence, not employee surveillance; the next page explains how that evidence is safely redacted.
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.6.3
041 · MD §D1.2.6.4 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.4

从真实操作到可使用知识：视频脱敏与安全处理From real work to usable knowledge: video redaction and safety

原始视频不能直接进入知识库。先限制采集范围，再识别和处理画面、声音与文字中的敏感信息，最后由授权人员复核。Raw video does not go directly into the knowledge base. Limit capture first, identify and handle sensitive visual, audio and text data, then perform authorised review.

1｜采集前控制1 | Controls before capture

  • 明确谁可以被录制、录制哪个任务、保存在哪里、保存多久、谁可以查看。Define who may be recorded, which task, where it is stored, how long and who may view it.
  • 使用指定窗口、指定时段和敏感页面黑名单；进入高风险页面时自动暂停或遮挡。Use selected windows, time limits and sensitive-page exclusions; pause or mask high-risk pages automatically.
  • 员工能看到录制状态，并知道用途、范围、留存和删除方式。Employees can see recording status and understand purpose, scope, retention and deletion.

2｜识别需要处理的内容2 | Identify data to handle

  • 画面：姓名、电话、地址、邮箱、账号、工单号、序列号、订单号和内部人员信息。Visuals: names, phones, addresses, emails, accounts, case IDs, serial numbers, order IDs and staff information.
  • 秘密：密码、验证码、Token、API Key、支付信息和证件信息必须重点拦截。Secrets: passwords, codes, tokens, API keys, payment and identity data require priority blocking.
  • 声音和文字同样处理：语音转录、OCR、窗口标题、复制粘贴内容都可能含有敏感信息。Audio and text also require handling: transcripts, OCR, window titles and clipboard content may contain sensitive data.

3｜按风险选择脱敏方式3 | Choose redaction by risk

  • 需要保留流程结构的字段，可替换为格式一致但非真实的值。Fields needed for process structure can be replaced with format-preserving but synthetic values.
  • 密码、验证码、Token、支付和证件信息直接遮挡或删除，不用“假值”继续保存。Passwords, codes, tokens, payment and identity data are masked or deleted, not retained as “fake values”.
  • 不需要原声时静音；需要语义时只保留已脱敏的文字或转录。Mute audio when it is not needed; when meaning is needed, retain only redacted text or transcript.

4｜自动处理后必须人工复核4 | Human review is mandatory

  • 复核画面、音频、OCR 和转录文本，确认敏感信息没有残留。Review video, audio, OCR and transcripts to confirm that sensitive data is not left behind.
  • 确认流程证据没有被误删；无法确认时整段不可用，不勉强进入知识库。Confirm that process evidence was not removed; if uncertain, reject the segment rather than forcing it into the knowledge base.
  • 原始视频不默认长期保存；脱敏结果也要带授权、版本、来源和访问记录。Raw video is not retained by default; redacted output also carries authorisation, version, source and access records.
讨论Discussion哪些信息必须保留来解释流程，哪些信息必须删除而不能进入下一步？Which information must remain to explain the process, and which must be removed before the next step?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.6.4
042 · MD §D1.2.6.5 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.5

从真实操作到本体：把专家经验变成系统知识From real work to ontology: turning expertise into system knowledge

脱敏后的操作证据先形成可审核 SOP，再把 SOP 中的对象、条件、动作和结果组织成本体；本体不是把文字换成技术名词。Redacted evidence first becomes an auditable SOP; its objects, conditions, actions and outcomes are then organised into an ontology. Ontology is more than renaming text with technical terms.

第一步｜从视频提取 SOPStep 1 | Extract an SOP from evidence

  • 触发条件：什么问题开始这个流程；输入信息：需要哪些字段。Trigger: what starts the flow; inputs: which fields are required.
  • 观察与判断：看到了什么状态，什么结果进入哪条路径。Observation and decision: what state was seen and which path follows.
  • 动作与例外：做什么处理，何时停止、补充信息或转人工。Action and exception: what to do, and when to stop, request data or hand over.
  • 完成条件：什么状态和证据证明任务已经完成。Completion: which state and evidence prove that the task is complete.

第二步｜由专家审核Step 2 | Expert review

  • 确认哪些步骤是业务必要，哪些只是个人习惯或一次性处理。Confirm which steps are business-critical and which are personal habit or one-off handling.
  • 确认适用范围、例外、不能自动执行的动作和人工接管点。Confirm scope, exceptions, forbidden automation and human takeover points.
  • 未经审核的推断、不确定内容和缺失信息不能直接成为规则。Unreviewed inference, uncertainty and missing data cannot become rules directly.

第三步｜SOP 变成本体Step 3 | Turn SOP into ontology

  • 对象关系：客户/设备/服务 → 问题 → 检查字段 → 判断条件 → 建议动作 → 结果状态。Relations: customer/device/service → issue → check field → condition → suggested action → outcome state.
  • 每条知识附带来源、版本、适用范围、审核人、生效和失效条件。Each knowledge item carries source, version, scope, reviewer, effective and expiry conditions.
  • 本体让系统能查询关系、解释建议，并知道何时必须转人工。Ontology lets the system query relationships, explain suggestions and know when to hand over.
讨论Discussion哪一部分是客户确认的业务知识，哪一部分只是系统对证据的整理？Which part is customer-confirmed business knowledge, and which part is only system organisation of evidence?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.6.5
043 · MD §D1.2.6.6 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.6

建议ISS CEC应用：动态 IVA 与流程智能辅助Proposed for ISS CEC: dynamic IVA and process intelligence assistance

以下是面向ISS CEC 的拓展建议，不是我方已交付能力：以本体关联设备、服务工单与已审核 SOP，支持个性化服务和坐席决策。These are proposed extensions for ISS CEC, not capabilities already delivered: relate devices, service cases and approved SOPs through ontology to support personalised service and agent decisions.

1｜建议ISS CEC：千人千面的动态 IVA1 | Proposed for ISS CEC: personalised IVA

  • 核验客户身份后，若维修工单状态可信，可优先询问是否查询维修进度，减少重复报机型和工单号。After verifying identity, a trusted repair-case status could prompt a repair-progress enquiry first, reducing repeated model and case details.
  • 若设备遥测获得授权且接口可用，可结合报错记录建议排查路径；报错不等于已确认故障原因，仍需客户确认来意。If authorised telemetry and interfaces are available, error records could suggest a diagnostic path; an error does not prove its cause, and the caller must confirm their intent.
  • 无法确认时回到通用流程或人工，不凭空猜测客户需求。When the state cannot be confirmed, return to the general flow or a person; do not guess.

2｜从流程建议到跨系统执行辅助2 | From process suggestions to cross-system execution assistance

  • 坐席在 Genesys 中输入“查一下这台电脑为什么上不了网”，系统先调用 KB，调出查网卡、连接状态和 ping 检查步骤。An agent enters “Check why this computer cannot connect to the internet” in Genesys. The system first calls the KB and brings up adapter, connection and ping checks.
  • 系统按已审核的 SOP 编排诊断工具、换货系统和工单系统：完成检查，形成“可能需要换货”的判断，准备地址和换货申请，并整理沟通内容与执行记录。Using an approved SOP, the system orchestrates diagnostic tools, the replacement system and case management: it completes checks, forms a “replacement may be needed” judgement, prepares the address and request, and assembles the conversation and execution record.
  • 系统做完后先报告判断、依据和准备执行的内容；坐席可以采纳、修改或拒绝，只有人确认后才提交换货或关闭工单。After completing the work, the system reports its judgement, evidence and prepared actions. The agent can accept, edit or reject them; replacement submission or case closure happens only after human confirmation.

3｜建议ISS CEC：用处理结果更新知识3 | Proposed for ISS CEC: improve knowledge from outcomes

  • 记录客户选择、坐席采纳或修改、人工接管、接口调用和最终状态。Record customer choice, agent adoption or correction, human takeover, calls and final state.
  • 发现某条 SOP 经常不能解决问题时，进入业务复核，而不是自动改规则。When an SOP often fails, send it for business review instead of changing rules automatically.
  • Genesys、知识、本体和业务系统形成可追踪的改进闭环。Genesys, knowledge, ontology and business systems form a traceable improvement loop.
讨论DiscussionISS CEC有哪些已授权的数据可支持这些建议？哪些身份核验、接口和专家审核条件还需补齐？Which authorised ISS CEC data could support these proposals, and which identity, interface and expert-review requirements remain?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.6.6
044 · MD §D1.2.6.7 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.7

ISS CEC项目：我们建议怎样开始ISS CEC project: how we recommend starting

ISS CEC只是应用方向示例，不代表已经完成交付；项目重点是用客户自己的知识、数据和接口，验证本体如何驱动 Genesys。ISS CEC is an application direction, not a completed delivery; the focus is to use the customer’s own knowledge, data and interfaces to validate ontology-driven Genesys flows.

起点建议｜先选一个能证明价值的场景Starting point | Choose one scenario that can prove value

  • 工单或维修状态联动：客户来电时，若状态可信，直接进入进度说明或相关人工路径。Case or repair-status linkage: when status is trusted, route directly to progress information or the relevant person.
  • 坐席实时辅助：根据客户描述、历史记录和已审核 SOP，提示下一步检查与回复。Real-time agent assist: use the description, history and approved SOP to suggest the next check and reply.
  • 动态分流：根据客户已授权的服务状态，减少重复询问并进入合适队列。Dynamic routing: use authorised service status to reduce repeated questions and route to the right queue.

推进建议｜先验证，再逐步扩大Delivery approach | Validate first, then expand

  • 先选一个低风险、高频、结果可核验的流程；不从全量 IT 客服开始。Start with one low-risk, frequent and verifiable flow; do not start with all IT support.
  • 采集真实操作，完成授权、脱敏、SOP 提取和客户专家审核。Capture real work, then complete authorisation, redaction, SOP extraction and customer-expert review.
  • 把客户确认的 SOP 转成本体，连接 Genesys、知识库、工单或其他业务系统。Turn customer-approved SOP into ontology and connect Genesys with knowledge, case and other systems.
  • 先做坐席辅助或可信状态分流，再根据结果决定是否扩大范围。Start with agent assist or trusted-state routing, then expand only from measured results.

启动前确认｜双方需要准备什么Before starting | What both sides need to prepare

  • 客户提供并确认业务知识、数据用途、接口权限和验收结果；我们提供方法、集成和能力建设。The customer provides and confirms business knowledge, data use, access and acceptance; we provide method, integration and capability building.
  • 未经授权、脱敏、审核和回归验证，不把视频、SOP 或本体直接用于线上服务。Without authorisation, redaction, review and regression, video, SOP or ontology does not enter live service.
讨论DiscussionISS CEC最适合先拿哪一个低风险流程，用真实结果证明这条能力链？Which low-risk ISS CEC flow is best to prove this capability chain with real results?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.6.7
045 · MD §D1.2.7.1 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.1

iCEO：先把业务边界说清iCEO: make the business boundary explicit first

已知：受控问答可行；当前复杂决策未达业务门槛。建议本轮先验证可追溯问答，不交付自动经营决策。Known: controlled Q&A is viable; complex decisions are below the business bar. Proposed: validate traceable Q&A first, not automated operating decisions.

改造前路径与痛点Current path and pain point

  • 知识采集 → 构建 PA（个人助理）→ 答复与决策。
  • 复杂决策同时依赖多维约束、动态背景、少量样本和隐性判断。
  • 演示流畅不能替代业务合格；本体不能补足缺失事实。
  • Knowledge capture → PA construction → answers and decisions.
  • Complex decisions depend on many constraints, dynamic context, sparse samples and tacit judgment.
  • A smooth demo is not business qualification; ontology cannot add missing facts.
预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：同一请求分别走 Q&A、证据不足拒答、复杂决策转人工；标注“真实／脱敏／模拟”。Record: one request through Q&A, evidence-insufficient refusal and decision hand-off; label “real / anonymized / simulated”.

此处仅为有意义的预留位，不含假 src 或外链。Meaningful reserved slot only; no fake src or external iframe.

讨论DiscussionISS 首个任务是问答、辅助建议还是正式决策？它的证据和责任边界是什么？Is the first ISS task Q&A, an assisted recommendation or a formal decision? What are its evidence and accountability boundaries?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.7.1
046 · MD §D1.2.7.2 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.2

受控闭环：答复、拒答、接管、回写A controlled loop: answer, refuse, hand off, write back

建议把可验证的问答闭环先做实；复杂决策遇到缺证据或高风险时必须停下并交给人。Proposed: make the verifiable Q&A loop real first; stop and hand off complex decisions when evidence is missing or risk is high.

正常任务Normal task

  • 校验身份、权限、来源和敏感范围。
  • 检索有权限知识，返回证据与时间标记。
  • 仅输出 Q&A、整理或可回退建议。
  • Check identity, access, sources and sensitive scope.
  • Retrieve authorized knowledge with evidence and timestamps.
  • Return Q&A, organization or reversible advice only.

缺失信息／异常Missing or abnormal

  • 缺目标、事实、授权或可靠来源：澄清或拒答。
  • 知识冲突、过期、越权或正式决策请求：进入异常分支。
  • 不把本体当作完整经营背景。
  • Missing goals, facts, authorization or sources: clarify or refuse.
  • Conflicts, stale knowledge, overreach or formal decisions: exception path.
  • Do not treat ontology as full operating context.

人确认、状态与结果Human, status and outcome

  • ISS Biz (team) 作为业务 Owner 与验收方；专家复核高风险输出。
  • 建议回写任务分类、知识版本、证据、人工结论和时间戳。
  • 当前不声称存在成功决策执行或经营收益。
  • ISS Biz (team) owns business acceptance; experts review high-risk output.
  • Proposed write-back: task type, knowledge version, evidence, human conclusion and timestamp.
  • No claim of successful decision execution or operating benefit.

047 · MD §D1.2.7.3 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.3

实施：把失败条件变成可回归机制Implementation: turn failure conditions into regression mechanisms

已知困难是决策维度多、背景动态、样本少；以下建设与采用路径均为建议，不是已完成运营结果。Known difficulties are many dimensions, dynamic context and sparse samples; the build and adoption path below is proposed, not a completed operating result.

输入与建设Inputs and build

  • 先分类 Q&A、辅助分析、建议、正式决策。
  • 标注来源、权限、敏感级别、有效期和责任人。
  • 用真实脱敏样本建立可答／澄清／拒答／转交标签。
  • Classify Q&A, analysis, advice and formal decisions first.
  • Label sources, access, sensitivity, validity and owners.
  • Use real anonymized samples for answer/clarify/refuse/hand-off labels.

困难与克服（建议）Difficulties and mitigations (proposed)

  • 设置权限门、证据门、任务分类门和人工确认门。
  • 保留原始输入、知识版本、上下文和失败样本。
  • 高风险请求设停止条件，变更后做回归。
  • Use access, evidence, task-type and human-approval gates.
  • Keep original input, knowledge version, context and failure samples.
  • Set stop conditions for high risk and regress after changes.

推动采用与持续改进（建议）Adoption and continuous improvement (proposed)

  • 从一个低风险、边界清晰的问答任务开始。
  • 展示来源、限制和接管路径，教育“可答不等于可决策”。
  • 反馈按错误级别进入迭代队列；不把未证实阻力写成历史事实。
  • Start with one low-risk, clearly bounded Q&A task.
  • Show sources, limits and hand-off; teach that answerable is not decision-ready.
  • Route feedback by error level; do not invent historical resistance.
讨论Discussion能提供哪些真实脱敏样本？谁维护知识有效期并批准回归通过？Which real anonymized samples are available? Who maintains knowledge validity and approves regression release?

组织与价值：先定义证据，再谈验收Organization and value: define evidence before acceptance

角色安排依据契约；实测质量、成本、收益和组织变化均未提供，页面只给出建议口径与待补证据。Roles follow the contract; measured quality, cost, benefit and organizational change are not provided. This page gives proposed measures and missing evidence only.

职责与交接Roles and hand-offs

  • ITEM：对接 COO AI Team/Hollis，协调扩展。
  • ISS Biz (team)：业务 Owner 与验收方。
  • DT：按需支撑数据、代码、软件、接口和跨部门。
  • 专家复核与责任授权：姓名、轮值待补。
  • ITEM: interface with COO AI Team/Hollis and coordinate extension.
  • ISS Biz (team): business owner and acceptance.

建议验收口径Proposed acceptance frame

050 · MD §D1.2.7.6 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.6

思考：把业务变更做成可审计链Reflection: make business change an auditable chain

复用的是边界、审核、评测和回滚机制；每个新场景仍需重新验证目标、授权、样本与风险。Reuse boundaries, review, evaluation and rollback; every new scenario still revalidates goals, authorization, samples and risk.

业务变更链（建议）Business change chain (proposed)

业务提规则 → 专家审核 → FDE 改 → 回归 → ISS Biz (team) 验收 → 发布 → 监测 → 回滚／停止

Business proposes rule → expert review → FDE changes → regression → ISS Biz (team) accepts → release → monitor → rollback / stop

每个节点保留版本、责任人、证据和批准记录。

Keep version, owner, evidence and approval at every node.

可沉淀到核心知识库Assets for the core knowledge base

  • 审核后的概念、约束、权限和敏感信息规则。
  • 问答／拒答流程、人工接管、升级和运营机制。
  • 评测集、错误标签、回归结果、Skill／提示版本。
  • Reviewed concepts, constraints, access and sensitivity rules.
  • Q&A/refusal flow, human hand-off, escalation and operations.
  • Evaluation sets, error labels, regressions and Skill/prompt versions.

复用与重验证Reuse and revalidation

  • 复用：任务分类、证据门、人工门、日志、错误级别。
  • 重验：目标、数据权限、时效、样本分布、专家判断、接口副作用。
  • Q&A 可行不代表新场景决策可行。
  • Reuse: task types, evidence and human gates, logs and error levels.
  • Revalidate goals, data access, freshness, sample mix, judgment and side effects.
  • Viable Q&A does not make a new decision scenario viable.
讨论Discussion当前谁批准规则、谁改实现、谁验收、谁能回滚？哪些知识有授权可沉淀？Who approves rules, changes implementation, accepts release and can roll back? Which knowledge is authorized to persist?

051 · MD §D1.2.7.7 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.7

可重复交付：小范围能力卡与停止机制Repeatable delivery: a small capability card and stop rule

失败例也可以复用方法，但不能强行产品化。现场只做一个可审计的小范围草稿，无法验收就停止或转交。A failure case can reuse method, but must not be forced into a product. Draft one auditable small-scope card; stop or hand off if it cannot be accepted.

六步交付法（建议）Six-step delivery (proposed)

  1. 选任务并分类。
  2. 写清权限、目标、禁止输出和停止条件。
  3. 准备真实脱敏样本并标注模拟样本。
  4. 配置知识、Skill、接口和状态回写。
  5. 评测引用、权限、拒答、转交和错误级别。
  6. ISS Biz (team) 决定发布、研究、停止或转交。
  1. Select and classify the task.
  2. Define access, goal, prohibited output and stop rule.
  3. Prepare real anonymized samples and label simulations.
  4. Configure knowledge, Skill, interfaces and write-back.
  5. Evaluate evidence, access, refusal, hand-off and error level.
  6. ISS Biz (team) decides release, research, stop or hand-off.

现场动手：能力卡Hands-on: capability card

  • 现场修改一条 Q&A 规则或转交流程。
  • 产出：输入、允许输出、拒答条件、人工接管、证据字段。
  • 补齐：验收分母／周期、错误级别、责任人、回滚条件。
  • Modify one Q&A rule or hand-off flow in the room.
  • Produce: inputs, allowed output, refusal, human hand-off and evidence fields.
  • Add denominator/period, error level, owner and rollback condition.

停止／转交门槛Stop / hand-off gate

若没有责任授权、真实样本或可验证目标，产出停止／转交草稿，不强行产品化；需要完整经营背景或稀缺数据的任务交给相应团队。

Without accountability, real samples or a testable goal, produce a stop/hand-off draft rather than force productization. Hand off tasks needing full operating context or scarce data.

待补：规则版本、样本、验收签字与回滚确认。

Missing: rule version, samples, acceptance sign-off and rollback confirmation.

讨论Discussion今天选择哪条规则？谁现场修改、谁验收？若证据不足，停止还是转交给谁？Which rule do we choose today? Who changes and accepts it? If evidence is missing, do we stop or hand off to whom?

052 · MD §D1.2.8.0 · 八案例与组织实践Eight cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.8.0 · 其他踩过的坑 / 总览OTHER FAILURE PATTERNS / OVERVIEW

其他踩过的坑：Other failure patterns:先定义可验收的业务结果define the business result before choosing the model

先看知识、业务执行、模型与本地化的教训，再回答：如何验证 Agent 在真实业务中可靠工作？Review lessons in knowledge, execution, models and localisation, then ask how to verify reliability in real business tasks.

下面展开的具体案例Cases covered next

01

知识抽取与知识生成Knowledge extraction and generation

从复杂资料识别信息、过滤噪音，再形成可检索、可复用的知识结构。Identify information in complex materials, filter noise, and form reusable knowledge structures.

02

WMS Agent：业务本体连接规则与动作WMS Agent: ontology connects rules to actions

从“找得到 API”走到理解业务规则、页面、对象和执行路径。Move from finding APIs to understanding rules, screens, objects and execution paths.

03

自建模型实验复盘Self-built model experiment review

用验证结果、14 个技术限制和路线差异，判断何时自建、何时采用 LLM。Use validation results, 14 technical limits and route differences to choose between building and adopting an LLM.

04

小模型训练复盘Small-model training review

BOL 与退货质检的教训：样本、规则与可解释性的边界，以及大小模型如何分工。Lessons from BOLs and returns: limits of samples, rules and explainability, and how to divide model tasks.

05

AI 招聘的跨国本地化AI recruitment localisation

系统出海需重新审核招聘问法、当地法规、文化习惯与数据使用。Review interview questions, local rules, cultural practices and data use for each market.

06

可信 Agent：一套标准，三重验证Agent assurance: one standard, three checks

以知识审核、任务测试和第三方评估，回答如何证明可靠。Verify reliability through reviewed knowledge, task tests and third-party evaluation.

共同根因Common root cause

先把业务结果定义清楚Define the business result first

每个案例都回到同一条验收链：输入是否明确、证据是否足够、谁能批准、谁来接管、结果如何回写。Every case returns to one acceptance chain: clear inputs, sufficient evidence, approval, takeover and write-back.

1任务：先选一个可验证的小范围问题Task: choose one bounded problem to validate
2证据：补齐来源、权限、样本和分母Evidence: source, access, samples and denominator
3责任：明确 Owner、人工接管与停止条件Ownership: owner, human takeover and stop conditions
4结果：回写业务状态，再决定是否扩展Result: write back the business state before scaling
