058 · MD §D1.2.8.3 · 自建模型实验复盘Self-built model experiment review
DAY 1 / MD §D1.2.8.3 / 自建模型实验复盘Self-built model experiment review

自建私有模型的 14 个技术限制14 technical limits of the private model

本次实验的断点分为四层，需结合具体业务任务逐项判断适用边界。The experiment's breakpoints fall into four layers; assess the boundary for each business task.

A · 训练数据层A · Training data
5 项5 items
A1
样本覆盖不足Insufficient sample coverage
每类约 100 条样本，难覆盖训练分布外表达。About 100 samples per class cannot cover out-of-distribution phrasing.
A2
新类别干扰旧类别New classes interfere with old ones
小样本类别加入全局训练，可能降低已有类别准确率。Adding a small class to global training may reduce existing-class accuracy.
A3
标注边界不统一Inconsistent label boundaries
各方分类口径不一致，产生矛盾标签。Different classification rules create conflicting labels.
A4
邮件上下文丢失Email context is lost
孤立标注和回复链切割，丢失语义或混入历史。Isolated labels and split reply chains lose meaning or mix in history.
A5
隐性业务知识缺失Implicit business knowledge is missing
BillTo、客户身份等判断依据不在邮件正文中。BillTo and customer identity are not stated in the email body.
B · 模型架构层B · Model architecture
4 项4 items
B1
识别与执行断层Gap between recognition and execution
槽位、API 编排、状态和回复需另建执行系统。Slots, API orchestration, state and replies require a separate execution system.
B2
分布外泛化不足Weak out-of-distribution generalisation
新表达容易识别失败，运行错误不会自动修正。New phrasing fails easily, and runtime errors do not self-correct.
B3
意图与系统错位Intent and system boundaries diverge
客户语言分类与内部系统功能边界不同。Customer-language categories differ from internal system functions.
B4
语言与字段脱节Language and fields are disconnected
“standard pallet”到尺寸字段需要领域映射。Mapping “standard pallet” to size fields needs domain knowledge.
C · 训练工程层C · Training engineering
3 项3 items
C1
标注能力难规模化Annotation expertise is hard to scale
人员需同时理解业务逻辑与统一的数据定义。People must understand both business logic and shared data definitions.
C2
数据反馈链中断The data feedback loop breaks
生产宕机影响邮件处理，也切断后续训练数据。Production outages affect email handling and cut off future training data.
C3
维护成本持续上升Maintenance cost keeps rising
新场景需重新采集、标注、训练，并回归旧场景。New scenarios require collection, annotation, training and regression.
D · 业务集成层D · Business integration
2 项2 items
D1
接口调用方式不匹配Interface invocation does not fit
面向人工表单的接口，需要参数与容错适配。Human-form interfaces need parameter and fault-tolerance adaptation.
D2
执行层缺位Execution layer is absent
识别后无接口可执行，只能返回预设数据或固定回复。Without executable interfaces, the system can only return preset data or fixed replies.

自建模型与 LLM：两种路线的能力边界Private NLP and LLM: capability boundaries

结合本次客服实验比较技术路线，按业务任务判断泛化、上下文与执行能力。Compare the routes through this service experiment, judging generalisation, context and execution by task.

比较维度Comparison dimension本次自建 NLP 方案This private NLP routeLLM 与工具集成路线LLM and tool integration
知识与泛化Knowledge and generalisation依赖本次标注数据Depends on this labelled data每类约 100 条，训练分布外表达覆盖不足。About 100 per class; out-of-distribution phrasing is under-covered.预训练提供语言基础Pre-training provides language foundations业务知识通过上下文、检索或工具补充，仍需评测。Business knowledge comes from context, retrieval or tools; evaluation is still required.
上下文与隐性知识Context and implicit knowledge邮件孤立处理Processes emails in isolation历史对话、BillTo、客户身份需额外建模。History, BillTo and customer identity need extra modelling.可结合历史与外部事实Can combine history and external facts上下文承接对话，工具查询补充业务信息。Context carries the dialogue; tools add business information.
识别到执行From recognition to execution另建任务执行系统Build a separate task system分类器之外，还需槽位、编排、状态与回复生成。Beyond classification, slots, orchestration, state and reply generation are needed.模型配合工具执行Model executes with tools工具调用仍依赖可用接口、权限、校验及人工接管。Tool calls still require interfaces, access, validation and human takeover.
新场景扩展New-scenario expansion重新标注、训练与回归Re-label, retrain and regress小样本新类别可能影响已有分类效果。A small new class may affect existing classification.调整知识、提示与工具Adjust knowledge, prompts and tools可缩短试验周期，变更后仍需回归验证。This can shorten experiments, but changes still need regression tests.
场景与选型Scenario and selection稳定、明确的专域任务Stable, bounded domain tasks需要充分数据、可控分类边界及持续维护能力。Needs enough data, controlled boundaries and sustained maintenance.多变语言与多轮任务Variable language and multi-turn tasks可评估客服、文档等场景；部署与成本另行比较。Evaluate service and document tasks; compare deployment and cost separately.
复盘Review以同一任务、同一评测集比较质量与全生命周期成本，再决定技术路线。Compare quality and lifecycle cost on the same task and test set before choosing a route.

060 · MD §D1.2.8.4 · 小模型训练复盘：样本、规则与可解释性的边界Small-model training review: limits of samples, rules and explainability
DAY 1 / MD §D1.2.8.4 / 小模型训练复盘：样本、规则与可解释性的边界Small-model training review: limits of samples, rules and explainability

BOL 识别与退货质检：样本不足，标签不够用BOL recognition and returns inspection: beyond samples and labels

长尾格式难攒样本，业务判断还需要规则、依据和解释。Long-tail formats lack samples; business decisions also need rules, evidence and explanations.

复盘维度ReviewCarrier BOL 识别Carrier BOL recognition退货质检：能否二次销售Returns inspection: fit for resale?
原先的设想Original plan
Carrier BOL 识别Carrier BOL recognition
按承运商做模板 OCR 或训练字段抽取模型，抽出 BOL 号、PRO 号、件数、重量、封签号。Use carrier-specific OCR templates or field extraction models for BOL and PRO numbers, piece count, weight and seal number.
退货质检Returns inspection
训练良品 / 次品分类模型，替代质检员判断退货能否二次销售。Train a pass/fail classifier to replace the inspector's decision on whether a returned item can be resold.
踩过的坑What went wrong
Carrier BOL 识别Carrier BOL recognition
头部承运商很快覆盖，长尾格式各异、每月只有几张，样本始终不够；关键的少件、破损信息又常是手写批注。Major carriers were covered quickly, but each long-tail format had only a few samples per month. Critical shortage and damage details were often handwritten.
退货质检Returns inspection
模型只给“次品”标签，说不清吊牌已剪、使用痕迹还是配件缺失；各货主标准不同，质检员还得重写说明。A fail label did not explain cut tags, signs of use or missing accessories. Owners had different standards; inspectors still had to write the explanation.
复盘后的认识Lesson learned
Carrier BOL 识别Carrier BOL recognition
承运商格式是持续增长的长尾，“先攒样本再训练”追不上变化；手写批注是自由文本，不是固定字段。Carrier formats form a growing long tail; collecting samples before each round of training cannot keep up. Handwritten notes are free text, not fixed fields.
退货质检Returns inspection
质检要看懂实物、套用该货主的规则，再解释结论；单一分类标签承载不了多套规则和判断理由。Inspection requires understanding the item, applying that owner's rules and explaining the result. A single class label cannot carry all three.
大模型承接什么Role of the large model
Carrier BOL 识别Carrier BOL recognition
读取新承运商首单，映射标准字段并与 ASN、PO 核对；单独提取手写异常批注，进入差异流程。Read a new carrier's first BOL, map standard fields and cross-check against ASN and PO records. Extract handwritten exceptions into the discrepancy workflow.
退货质检Returns inspection
读入货主退货政策，给出能否二次销售的结论、依据条款与问题描述，回传货主。Read the owner's returns policy and provide a resale decision, supporting clauses and a problem description for the owner.
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.8.4
061 · MD §D1.2.8.4 · 小模型训练复盘：样本、规则与可解释性的边界Small-model training review: limits of samples, rules and explainability
DAY 1 / MD §D1.2.8.4 / 小模型训练复盘：样本、规则与可解释性的边界Small-model training review: limits of samples, rules and explainability

如何选型：小模型、大模型，还是两者配合Choosing small models, large models or both

先看任务是否稳定、是否要实时、是否必须解释，再选择模型分工。Choose the division of work by task stability, response time and the need for explanations.

小模型Small model

目标固定、要实时、调用量大Fixed targets, real-time response, high volume

  • 园区车辆车牌识别Vehicle plate recognition
  • 月台有没有车停靠Dock occupancy detection
  • 安全帽、反光衣佩戴检测Hard-hat and reflective-vest detection
  • 卡车停靠后是否放置轮挡Wheel chocks after docking

识别对象长期不变，样本好采集，需要实时响应。Targets stay stable, samples are easy to collect and response must be immediate.

大模型Large model

低频、开放、结果要给人看Lower frequency, open-ended tasks, human-readable results

  • 读各家承运商的提单Read BOLs from different carriers
  • 退货能不能再卖、为什么Explain whether returns can be resold
  • 按货主要求查装柜打托Check loading and palletising rules
  • 查危险品标签贴得对不对Check hazardous-goods labelling

样本攒不起来，规则写在文档里，结果需要讲清原因。Samples are sparse, rules live in documents and decisions need an explanation.

小模型 + 大模型Small + large models

小模型盯全程，大模型做判断Continuous detection, contextual judgement

  • 人车靠太近时报警Alerts when people and vehicles get too close
  • 丢了货，翻录像找去向Trace missing goods through video
  • 巡检拍照盘点库位Inventory locations from inspection photos
  • 月台装卸时有没有抛扔货物Detect goods being thrown during handling

全部交给大模型太慢太贵；只靠小模型，误报多、说不清。Using only a large model is slow and costly; using only a small model can leave false alarms unexplained.

一句话判断：要反复标注、反复改规则，或最终总要人看一眼，就别让小模型独自硬扛。Rule of thumb: If labels or rules keep changing, or a person always needs to review the result, do not rely on a small model alone.

062 · MD §D1.2.8.5 · AI 招聘的跨国本地化AI recruitment localisation
DAY 1 / MD §D1.2.8.5 / AI 招聘的跨国本地化AI recruitment localisation

AI 招聘踩过的坑：系统出海，规则不能照搬AI recruitment lesson: localisation goes beyond language

我们曾做过 AI 招聘与面试系统，设计时主要考虑中国的招聘习惯与文化；用于美国招聘后，收到了候选人投诉。We built an AI recruitment and interview system around Chinese hiring practices and culture. When used for US recruitment, it drew candidate complaints.

我们的 AI 面试界面Our AI interview interface

产品界面示例，不代表截图中的候选人是投诉者，也不证明下列问题曾在该场面试中出现。含姓名、面部及会话信息，对外发布前须确认授权或脱敏。Product interface only: the pictured candidate is not identified as the complainant, nor does the image establish that these questions were asked. It contains personal and session details; confirm permission or redact before external release.

容易照搬的习惯，与应该改的问法Habits that travel badly—and better questions

工资历史Salary history

“现在工资多少？上一份工资多少？”部分州和地方限制询问或使用薪资历史。改问薪酬预期，并说明岗位预算。“What do you earn now? What did your last job pay?” Some states and cities restrict salary-history enquiries or use. Ask expectations and explain the role’s pay range.

婚姻与生育Marriage and family plans

“结婚了吗？有孩子吗？打算生育吗？”这些私人信息可能成为歧视证据。只问与岗位有关的出差和工作安排。“Are you married? Do you have or plan to have children?” These private enquiries may become discrimination evidence. Ask only about job-related travel and schedules.

年龄Age

“多大了？这个年纪还能适应吗？”不要用年龄推断能力，统一核实岗位技能和客观要求；联邦年龄保护主要针对40岁及以上人群。“How old are you? Can you keep up at your age?” Assess skills and objective job requirements, not age. Federal age protection primarily covers people aged 40 and over.

加班与家庭安排Overtime and family arrangements

“孩子谁带？能保证随时加班吗？”可以说明加班要求，但不要追问家庭。统一问能否满足明确的工作时间，并保留依法申请合理便利的渠道。“Who looks after your children? Can you always work overtime?” Explain actual schedule requirements without probing family life, and preserve legally required accommodation channels.

做系统不只是翻译语言，更要按服务所在地检查文化、法律和招聘习惯：评估能否胜任工作，不用私人信息推断是否值得雇佣。Building for another market takes more than translation: review local culture, law and hiring practices. Assess ability to do the job, not private circumstances as a proxy for employability.

以上为风险提示，不表示所有问法在所有情境下一律违法；上线前由当地 HR 与法律顾问按联邦、州及地方规则审核问题库、录音录像告知和数据使用。Risk flags, not claims that every question is unlawful in every situation. Local HR and counsel should review questions, recording notices and data use against federal, state and local rules before release.

063 · MD §D1.2.8.6 · 可信 Agent：一套标准，三重验证Trustworthy agents: one set of standards, three checks
DAY 1 / MD §D1.2.8.6 / 可信 Agent：一套标准，三重验证Trustworthy agents: one set of standards, three checks

可信 Agent：一套标准，三重验证Trustworthy agents: one set of standards, three checks

人工审核知识、自动化测试任务、第三方交叉评估，以同一套标准回答“如何证明可靠”。Human-reviewed knowledge, automated task tests and third-party evaluation provide evidence against one set of standards.

开场短片 · 1分42秒Opening film · 1:42
01 / 04

视频暂时无法播放。The video could not be played. 打开视频文件Open video file

安全有边界，可信有标准Clear boundaries. Explicit standards for trust.

验收前由业务负责人明确：开放给谁、使用哪些数据与工具、允许执行哪些动作。Before acceptance testing, the business owner defines the users, data, tools and permitted actions.

安全可控Safe and controlled

仅使用授权数据与工具；高影响动作须预览并有效确认，取消生效后不得新增外部操作。Use only authorized data and tools. Preview and obtain valid confirmation for high-impact actions; no new external actions after cancellation takes effect.

知识可信Grounded in evidence

关键结论须有来源与证据支持；无证据、无权限或超范围时，应拒答或提示不确定。Support key conclusions with sources and evidence. Refuse or signal uncertainty when evidence or permission is absent, or the request is out of scope.

结果可验Verifiable outcomes

关键任务须留存执行记录与外部回执；核对参数、回执，以外部系统最终状态判定完成。Retain execution records and external receipts for key tasks. Check parameters and receipts; judge completion by the final external state.

验收通过条件Acceptance pass criteria红线事件为 0 · 必须项全通过 · 适用核心指标达标Zero red-line events · All mandatory checks pass · Applicable core targets met

人工把关，构建可信的知识基础Human review builds a trusted knowledge foundation.

业务专家与实施团队共同确认业务知识，为 Agent 回答与第三方评估提供依据。Business experts and the delivery team validate the knowledge used to ground agent answers and third-party evaluation.

真实来源Business sources

从业务数据、SOP 与真实操作中提取知识，保留来源。Extract knowledge from business data, SOPs and real operations, retaining its sources.

专家审核Expert review

业务专家审核知识内容，确认定义、规则与例外。Business experts review the knowledge content and confirm definitions, rules and exceptions.

验证发布Validate and release

用场景样本验证后发布，运行中的问题反馈给知识负责人。Validate with scenario samples before release; feed operational issues back to the knowledge owner.

知识沉淀Knowledge foundation经人工审核与场景验证，业务数据沉淀为语义确定性底座（Ontology）。Reviewed and scenario-validated business data forms an Ontology — a foundation of well-defined business semantics.

自动化测试，让验证持续、高效、可复用Automated testing: continuous, efficient and reusable.

固定测试用例与被测版本，形成可量化、可复验的测试记录。Fix the test cases and tested version to produce measurable, repeatable test records.

自动化执行与核对Automated execution and checks

  • 脚本批量执行，留存输入与输出Run scripts in batches; retain inputs and outputs
  • LLM 对照标准答案集（Gold Set）核对答案Use an LLM to check answers against the Gold Set
  • 复用用例与评估口径，变更后回归复验Reuse cases and evaluation criteria; rerun after changes
  • 业务人员介入评估Business users participate in evaluation

验收参考门槛Reference acceptance thresholds

端到端任务成功率End-to-end task success≥85%关键流程 ≥90%Critical workflows ≥90%
工具参数正确且外部状态符合预期Correct tool parameters and expected external state≥90%
高影响动作预览与有效确认Preview and valid confirmation for high-impact actions100%
人工把关Human oversight人工定义预期结果，复核结论与业务系统状态，确认问题整改。People define expected results, review answers and business-system state, and confirm corrections.

第三方交叉评估，多一重可信保障Third-party evaluation adds another layer of assurance.

已使用第三方 Evaluation Agent 评估输出与执行过程；争议与高风险结果由人工复核，业务负责人依据证据验收。A third-party Evaluation Agent has assessed outputs and execution. People review disputed or high-risk results; the business owner accepts the work based on evidence.

评估依据Evaluation evidence

已审核知识与预期结果
输出内容与执行记录Reviewed knowledge and expected results
Outputs and execution records

第三方评估Third-party evaluation

Evaluation Agent
交叉核验输出与执行过程Cross-check outputs and execution

评估结果Evaluation findings

准确性 · 证据一致性
任务完成情况与问题项Accuracy · Evidence consistency
Task completion and issues

刻度Scale 0–100%

≥85%

≥90%

统一身份、任务、结果和异常处理；现有 WMS、Genesys、ISS 仍可作为业务工作面。Unify identity, tasks, results and exceptions while WMS, Genesys and ISS remain business work surfaces.

从输入到行动From input to action

业务输入Business input→语义与知识Semantics & knowledge→Data / Model / Tools→Agent / Workflow→受控执行Controlled action→平台与能力回写Platform & capability writeback

入口要回答的问题Questions the entry must answer

  • 当前任务、依据的事实、建议原因、待确认事项、执行结果和查看位置。
  • 统一入口不等于强迫所有工作进入聊天；接口和运行记录才是连接点。

两类回写：业务事实与知识能力Two writebacks: business facts and capability knowledge

建议、调用成功和业务执行成功必须分开记录；未经审核的推断不能覆盖正式事实。Separate recommendation, call success and business execution success; unreviewed inference must not overwrite facts.

回写业务平台Write back to business systems

  • 订单/任务状态、流程结果、确认记录和必要动作。Order/task status, workflow result, approvals and necessary actions.
  • 明确源系统、写入权限、幂等、重试、冲突和追踪标识。Define source, write permission, idempotency, retry, conflict and trace ID.

回写能力与知识Write back capability and knowledge

  • 执行日志、失败、人工修正、经审核 SOP 与知识缺口。Execution logs, failures, human fixes, reviewed SOPs and knowledge gaps.
  • 反馈到 UKM、本体、Skill、Agent 和治理平台。Feed UKM, ontology, Skill, Agent and governance layers.

MD §D1.3.1 · Day 1

从建议到执行的责任边界The accountability boundary from suggestion to action

工具返回不等于业务完成；权限、审批、幂等、重试和冲突必须成为运行条件。A tool response is not business completion; permissions, approval, idempotency, retries and conflicts are runtime conditions.

查询Query

  • 读取也要受权限、敏感信息和来源约束。Reads still require access, sensitive-data and source controls.
  • 明确返回时点、范围和证据。Define return time, scope and evidence.

写入Write

  • 高风险动作需要人工确认或审批。High-risk actions need human confirmation or approval.
  • 设置幂等、重试、冲突处理和回滚。Set idempotency, retry, conflict handling and rollback.

完成Completion

  • 日志记录工具结果与业务实际结果。Log tool result separately from actual business result.
  • 异常必须接管，责任人可追溯。Exceptions require takeover and traceable ownership.

Data Hub：可信事实与可追溯上下文Data Hub: trusted facts and traceable context

互联不是完整，也不等于可训练；每个输入都要保留来源、时间、版本、权限和质量。Connected does not mean complete or trainable; every input keeps source, time, version, access and quality.

可用输入Possible inputs

  • CRM/订单、维修、物料库存、物流 ETA。CRM/orders, field service, materials/inventory and logistics ETA.
  • UKM/EKP/EKF、SOP/PRD、邮件/历史记录。UKM/EKP/EKF, SOP/PRD, email and history.
  • 授权代码与多模态提取结果。Authorized code and multimodal extraction results.

可信上下文Trusted context

  • 映射统一业务定义，保留来源和有效时间。Map to shared business definitions while keeping provenance and validity.
  • 接入前确认用途、权限、质量和责任 Owner。Confirm purpose, access, quality and owner before connection.

Connector、Tools、Skill 与技术 MarketplaceConnector, Tools, Skill and the technical Marketplace

连接、封装和复用必须有权限、质量、版本与 Owner；Marketplace 是技术能力层，不是业务商城。Connection, encapsulation and reuse need access, quality, version and ownership; the Marketplace is technical, not a business store.

Connector

连接授权系统与上下文，明确接口和失败处理。Connect authorized systems and context with explicit interfaces and failure handling.

Tools

封装查询与 Action，定义输入、输出、权限和审计。Encapsulate queries and Actions with input, output, access and audit defined.

Skill

表达可重复能力及业务责任，支持测试和版本化。Express repeatable capability and business ownership for testing and versioning.

Marketplace

登记、发现、复用和治理技术能力，不以入驻数量替代价值。Register, discover, reuse and govern technical capability; listings do not equal value.

Dashboard 连接采用、质量与成本Dashboard connects adoption, quality and cost

Dashboard 面向人，回答业务得到什么；路由和内部计量用于比较能力与单位成本，不承诺价格。The Dashboard serves people and business outcomes; routing and internal metering compare capability and unit cost without price promises.

业务视角Business view

  • 采用用户/团队、有效任务、质量、异常和结果。Adopting users/teams, effective tasks, quality, exceptions and outcomes.
  • 按周期、版本和口径解释变化。Explain changes by period, version and metric definition.

成本视角Cost view

  • Token、调用次数、GPU 时间、服务实例或能力包。Tokens, calls, GPU time, service instances or capability packages.
  • 把人工介入和维护纳入单位业务成本。Include human intervention and maintenance in unit business cost.

路由原则Routing principle

  • 简单任务用规则、模板、缓存或小模型。Use rules, templates, cache or small models for simple tasks.
  • 复杂任务再调用适合的大模型与上下文。Call a suitable large model and context only for complex tasks.

让业务人员用标准入口表达目标；重复任务可后台运行，但必须保留异常接管。Let business users express goals through standard entry points; repetitive work may run in background with exception takeover.

标准化Standardization

  • 创新使用标准组件和边界。Innovation uses standard components and boundaries.
  • 避免无限个人定制和无法维护的孤岛。Avoid unmaintainable personal customization and silos.

Robotics / Token Saving

  • 状态监控、整理、派发、同步和提醒可事件驱动。Monitoring, organization, dispatch, sync and reminders can be event-driven.

Ontology 共建：按任务复杂度选择规模Co-build ontology at the right task scale

从采集到反馈形成闭环；业务 Owner 负责定义与价值，专业团队补事实、工具与方法。Close the loop from collection to feedback; the business owner owns definition and value while specialists add facts, tools and method.

共建闭环Co-building loop

采集Collect→提取Extract→业务/专家审核Review→对象·关系·规则·ActionModel→样本验证Validate→发布与反馈Release & feedback

按复杂度选规模Choose scale by complexity

  • 简单、稳定任务：轻量规则或结构化模板。Simple, stable tasks: lightweight rules or structured templates.
  • 跨系统、状态和约束：小范围本体与授权数据。Cross-system states and constraints: bounded ontology and authorized data.
  • 复杂任务：逐步扩展，不以“全组织本体”为起点。Complex tasks: expand gradually, not from an enterprise-wide ontology.

MD §D1.3.4 · Day 1 · 知识状态

原始记录、草稿、审核与发布不可混用Raw records, drafts, review and release must stay separate

知识状态是执行边界：来源、Owner、有效期和不确定性必须随状态流转。Knowledge state is an execution boundary: source, owner, validity and uncertainty travel with every state.

原始与提取Raw and extracted

  • 原始记录保留来源与上下文。Raw records keep provenance and context.
  • AI 提取结果标注生成方式和不确定性。AI extraction labels method and uncertainty.

草稿与审核Draft and reviewed

  • SOP 草稿不得冒充已批准规则。An SOP draft is not an approved rule.
  • 专家审核记录结论、例外和责任人。Expert review records conclusions, exceptions and owner.

发布与更新Released and updated

  • 无来源、Owner 或有效期的知识不进高风险执行。Knowledge without source, owner or validity stays out of high-risk execution.
  • 错误版本要可发现、回退和更新。Wrong versions must be discoverable, reversible and updateable.

079 · MD §D1.3.5 · 平台与持续演进Platform and evolution
MD §D1.3.5 · Day 1 · 从一次成功到重复交付MD §D1.3.5 · Day 1 · From one success to repeatable delivery

平台演进：把业务变更变成可回归的长期资产Platform evolution: turn business change into regressed, durable assets

平台价值不在于把所有场景搬进同一入口，而在于让规则变化有责任、有回归、有发布/回滚，并能在第二场景重验。Platform value is not moving every scene into one entry. It is giving rule changes ownership, regression, release/rollback and re-validation in a second scene.

业务变更闭环Business-change loop

01

业务提新规则Business proposes rule

02

专家审核Expert review

03

FDE 改FDE changes

04

回归Regression

05

发布 / 回滚Release / rollback

每一步留下版本、样本、审核结论、影响范围与责任人；这是建议方法，不是对既有历史演进结果的断言。Keep version, samples, review decision, impact and owner at every step; this is a proposed method, not a claim about historical evolution.

可进入授权核心知识库的资产Assets for an authorized core knowledge base

知识Knowledge

来源、有效期、审核人和可见范围。Provenance, validity, reviewer and visibility.

语义Semantics

对象、关系、状态、规则与决策边界。Objects, relations, states, rules and decision boundaries.

SkillSkills

输入、输出、权限、失败路径、Owner 与版本。Inputs, outputs, access, failure paths, Owner and version.

评测 / 运营Evaluation / operations

独立样本、质量门、运行日志、成本、接管和退出条件。Independent samples, quality gates, run logs, cost, takeover and exit conditions.

第二场景复用前重验Re-validate before a second scene

  • 重验权限、规则、数据语义、接口和质量门。
  • 区分可直接复用、需配置、需适配和不可外推。
  • 新场景的业务 Owner 对验收和例外负责。
  • Recheck access, rules, data semantics, interfaces and quality gates.
  • Separate direct reuse, configuration, adaptation and non-transferable parts.
  • The new business Owner owns acceptance and exceptions.
讨论焦点Discussion哪条变更链能让首个成功变成第二个场景的可验证交付，而不是复制幻觉？Which change chain can turn the first success into verifiable delivery in a second scene, rather than an illusion of copy-paste?

080 · MD §D1.4.1 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.1 · Agent 输出准确性

准确性：以任务、风险和证据定义门槛Accuracy: define the gate by task, risk and evidence

“90%”不能脱离任务、分母、版本和风险谈；正确率只是质量的一部分。“90%” has no meaning without task, denominator, version and risk; accuracy is only one quality dimension.

按任务拆开Split by task

  • 检索/回答、规则判断、分类、预测、方案建议Retrieval/answer, rules, classification, prediction and recommendation
  • 实际执行分别定义输入、输出和完成条件Define input, output and completion per task

按证据评测Evaluate evidence

  • 独立样本、正常/异常/边界、专家判定、版本记录Independent samples, normal/exception/boundary, expert labels, versions
  • 失败分类、覆盖率、缺失信息、响应时间与成本Failure classes, coverage, missing information, time and cost

按风险设门Gate by risk

重点看高风险失败；系统要能引用来源、澄清、拒答、回退和升级，不能靠模型自评。Inspect high-risk failures; the system must cite, clarify, refuse, fall back and escalate. Self-rating is not proof.

决策输出Decision output首个场景的评测对象、分母、指标、错误等级、人工确认和上线门槛；BO 90% 口径回到 §D1.2.4。Define the first scenario’s evaluation object, denominator, metrics, error levels, human confirmation and release gate; BO 90% returns to §D1.2.4.
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)MD §D1.4.1 · R5
081 · MD §D1.4.2 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.2 · 编排定义

Super Agent：业务编排，不是无限权限Super Agent: orchestration, not unlimited access

先问首个场景是否真的需要跨能力编排；简单流程足够时，不额外增加复杂度。First ask whether the scenario needs cross-capability orchestration; do not add complexity when a simple flow is enough.

工作定义Working definition

围绕业务目标，在授权范围内理解上下文、拆解任务、调用已验证 Skill/Agent/Tools、处理异常并请求人工确认。Around a business goal, understand context within authorization, decompose tasks, call verified Skills/Agents/Tools, handle exceptions and request human confirmation.

必须写清Make explicit

  • 目标与范围、子能力输入/输出、最大权限Goal/scope, sub-capability inputs/outputs and maximum access
  • 失败/终止条件、上下文隔离、调用成本、最终 OwnerFailure/stop conditions, context isolation, call cost and final Owner

不能越过Must not cross

  • 不能凭空增加事实或越权调用另一 AgentIt cannot invent facts or use another Agent’s access
  • 工具返回不等于业务任务完成A tool response is not business completion

决策输出Decision output

首个场景是否需要 Master/Group/Super Agent；若不需要，保留简单流程。Decide whether the first scenario needs a Master/Group/Super Agent; otherwise keep the simpler flow.

讨论焦点Discussion哪个业务目标需要编排？最大权限和最终 Owner 是谁？Which business goal needs orchestration? What is the maximum access and final Owner?

082 · MD §D1.4.3 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.3 · 能力边界

SupplyX：先确认范围，再比较复用边界SupplyX: Confirm Scope Before Comparing Reuse

SupplyX 的具体产品、内部版本、责任团队、能力范围与成熟度当前未知；不按名称臆测功能，也不预设替代。The SupplyX product, internal version, team, scope and maturity are unknown; do not infer function or assume replacement.

先补事实Confirm first

  • 具体产品/版本、责任团队、用户入口
  • 已有数据、本体、模型、Agent/Skill 与成熟度
  • Product/version, responsible team and user entry
  • Existing data, ontology, models, Agents/Skills and maturity

同场景比较Compare in one scenario

  • 流程覆盖、接口与 Action、规则与评测
  • 权限、治理、部署、运营成本与产品责任
  • Flow coverage, interfaces/Actions, rules and evaluation
  • Access, governance, deployment, operations cost and product ownership

边界分类Boundary categories

直接复用｜标准接入｜补充开发｜确有重复｜暂不涉及

Direct reuse | Standard integration | Add-on build | True overlap | Out of scope

决策输出Decision output

形成能力边界表，选择一个同场景验证；不是先比功能清单再决定迁移。

Create a capability boundary table and validate one shared scenario; do not decide migration from feature lists.

083 · MD §D1.4.4 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.4 · 入口融合

Copilot：保留入口，验证能力融合Copilot: Keep the Entry, Verify the Integration

Copilot 的产品、版本与实际实施范围待确认；先沿同一业务链验证能力和授权，不承诺无缝融合。Copilot product, version and implementation are unconfirmed; verify capability and authorization along one flow, without promising seamless fusion.

先确认Confirm first

  • 产品/版本、实施范围、用户入口与身份
  • 知识、接口、日志、平台回写和实际权限
  • Product/version, implementation, entry and identity
  • Knowledge, interfaces, logs, writeback and actual access

同链比较Compare on one chain

  • 知识访问、页面/代码生成、业务语义
  • Workflow、受控 Action、日志与状态回写
  • Knowledge access, page/code generation and business semantics
  • Workflow, controlled Actions, logs and state writeback

融合边界Integration boundary

优先复用现有入口、身份、知识与能力；缺口再由 ITEM/COO AI 补充，统一权限与业务状态。

Prefer the existing entry, identity, knowledge and capability; fill gaps with ITEM/COO AI while keeping access and state aligned.

决策输出Decision output入口是否保留、哪些能力以 Connector/Tools/Skill 接入、哪些要扩展；技术与授权待验证。Decide what entry remains, what connects through Connector/Tools/Skill and what needs extension; technology and authorization remain to be verified.

084 · MD §D1.4.5 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.5 · 业务价值 / 1

Agent 热活报告：采用和有效任务Agent Activity: Adoption and Effective Tasks

“热活报告”只是工作名称；调用多不等于成功，必须把采用、任务、质量、成本和结果连起来。“Activity report” is a working name; more calls do not equal success. Connect adoption, tasks, quality, cost and outcomes.

采用层Adoption

看什么避免什么
活跃用户/团队、活跃 Agent、重复使用、场景覆盖试用、失败重试或后台自调用造成虚假繁荣
Agent/Skill 版本、Owner、观测周期、基线没有口径却横向比较
MeasureAvoid
Active users/teams, Agents, repeat use and scenario coverageTrials, retries or background self-calls inflating activity
Agent/Skill version, Owner, period and baselineComparisons without a defined scope

任务层Task completion

必须连到不能只记
有效业务任务、完成率、异常、人工接管、Action/回写成功模型答复或工具返回次数
按场景、Owner、周期报告把调用量当价值
Connect toDo not only count
Valid tasks, completion, exceptions, takeover and Action/writeback successModel replies or tool-return counts
Report by scenario, Owner and periodCall volume as value

决策输出Decision output

第一轮价值基线、数据来源、报告周期、业务签认人与继续投入标准。

First-round baseline, data source, reporting period, business sign-off and reinvestment standard.

风险提醒Risk reminder

质量与风险另行看：关键错误、拒答/转人工、知识更新和来源不能被平均活跃度掩盖。

Quality and risk need separate views: critical errors, refusal/handoff, knowledge updates and sources cannot hide behind average activity.

讨论焦点Discussion首个场景什么才算“有效业务任务”？由谁签认？What counts as an effective business task in the first scenario, and who signs it off?

085 · MD §D1.4.5 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.5 · 业务价值 / 2

业务价值：基线、成本与实际结果Business Value: Baseline, Cost and Outcomes

价值不能用历史收益或毛节省代替；先建立同口径基线，再核算新增运行、维护和人工审核成本。Value cannot be replaced by historical benefits or gross savings; establish a common baseline and include new run, maintenance and review costs.

效率与净成本Efficiency & net cost

  • 处理时间、人工确认、返工
  • 单位任务成本、Token/算力、维护成本
  • 净成本须扣除新增运行与必要人工审核
  • Handling time, human confirmation and rework
  • Unit-task cost, tokens/compute and maintenance
  • Net cost includes new run and required human review

业务结果Business outcomes

  • Customer Promise、BO 关闭、物流异常
  • 维修/流程周期、客户体验
  • 必须有基线、同一统计范围与业务 Owner 验证
  • Customer Promise, BO closure and logistics exceptions
  • Repair/process cycle and customer experience
  • Require a baseline, same scope and business-owner validation

复用与表达Reuse & framing

优先讲减少重复工作、提升服务、扩大同等团队处理能力；不把价值只讲成减员。

Lead with less repetition, better service and more capacity for the same team—not only headcount reduction.

讨论焦点Discussion哪一个业务结果已有基线，哪一项仍需采集？净成本由谁确认？Which outcome has a baseline, which needs data, and who confirms net cost?

086 · MD §D1.4.6 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.6 · AP 盘点 / 1

AP 的 Agent：先取得可复用清单AP Agents: Build the Reuse Inventory

AP 的准确含义、责任人和 Agent/Skill 清单尚待确认；数量只是盘点起点，不是复用证明。AP’s meaning, Owners and Agent/Skill list remain to be confirmed; quantity is only an inventory start, not proof of reuse.

先取得事实Confirm first

  • AP 的准确含义、责任人、清单与运行环境
  • 每个 Agent/Skill 的业务功能与输入输出
  • AP meaning, Owners, inventory and runtime
  • Business function and inputs/outputs per Agent/Skill

逐项盘点Inventory each item

  • 模型与数据依赖、权限、接口与 Owner
  • 质量、成本、版本、部署与维护
  • Model/data dependencies, access, interface and Owner
  • Quality, cost, version, deployment and maintenance

输出清单Inventory output

试复用清单｜缺口与适配工作｜Owner｜评测条件｜本轮不接入项

Reuse candidates | Gaps/adaptation | Owners | Evaluation conditions | Not included now

治理原则Governance

先盘点和评估，再标准接入；不要求几十个 Agent 一次性重写或迁移。

Inventory and assess before standard integration; do not rewrite or migrate dozens of Agents at once.

087 · MD §D1.4.6 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.6 · AP 盘点 / 2

AP 复用：分类接入，不一次性重写AP Reuse: Classify, Integrate, Don’t Rewrite All

按成熟度和场景决定处理方式；Hollis 阶段治理支持先评估、再标准接入。Choose treatment by maturity and scenario; Hollis stage governance supports assessment before standard integration.

类别处理方式
能力清楚、质量/权限满足尽量直接复用，登记接口与 Owner。
价值明确、接口/元数据不统一适配后接入，保留原运行环境。
规则或范围不匹配明确改造，重新评测，不跨场景外推。
CategoryTreatment
Clear capability, quality/access fitPrefer direct reuse; register interface and Owner.
Value clear, interface/metadata inconsistentAdapt and connect; retain runtime.
Rules or scope mismatchDefine change and reevaluate; no cross-scenario extrapolation.
类别处理方式
多个 Agent 功能重复比较实际质量、采用和成本，再合并或保留互补。
缺 Owner/权限/质量不明/风险高先登记待评估，不直接进入生产编排。
CategoryTreatment
Overlapping AgentsCompare actual quality, adoption and cost; merge or retain complementary items.
Missing Owner/access, unclear quality or high riskRegister for assessment; do not put directly into production orchestration.

验收与边界Gate & boundary

输出试复用清单、缺口、Owner、评测条件和本轮不接入项；是否统一托管由成熟度和场景决定。

Output reuse candidates, gaps, Owners, evaluation conditions and exclusions; unified hosting depends on maturity and scenario.

不要做的事Do not

不因数量多就全部迁移，不因接口相似就跳过业务规则、权限、质量和维护确认。

Do not migrate everything because the count is large or skip rules, access, quality and maintenance checks because interfaces look similar.

088 · MD §D1.4.7 · 风险与原则Risks and principles
MD §D1.4.7 · Day 1

把风险结论带入实施与第二天决策Carry risk evidence into implementation

风险不是最后一轮泛泛讨论，而是四字段的证据、责任与条件：D1.5 初填，第二天深化并确认。Convert risks into evidence, owners and conditions for the four fields; seed D1.5 and deepen decisions on Day 2.

① 场景与验收① Scenario and acceptance

明确任务、分母、独立样本、错误等级与人工门槛；回填首个场景、用户、范围、排除项与业务基线。评测样本和业务判定人为 D1.5 初步验收提供证据。Define task, denominator, independent samples, error severity and human gate. Record scenario, users, scope, exclusions and baseline; business reviewers supply evidence for initial D1.5 acceptance.

② 团队与 Owner② Team and owners

明确 ISS Biz、COO AI／ITEM、专家、审批、运维及按需 DT 的责任。未确认人员、接口或资源保持显式状态；D2.4 深化责任矩阵、权限与人工接管。Name ISS Biz, COO AI/ITEM, expert, approval, operations and as-needed DT responsibilities. Keep unconfirmed resources explicit; D2.4 refines the responsibility matrix, access and human hand-off.

③ 能力输入与执行边界③ Inputs and execution boundaries

平台融合和 AP 复用转为数据、代码、模型、接口、权限、日志、成本及依赖清单。区分真实、模拟、建议和人工确认；D2.2–3 验证材料与生命周期，Marketplace 管技术、Dashboard 看业务。Translate platform fit/AP reuse into data/code/model/interface/access/log/cost dependencies. Separate real, simulated, advisory and human-approved actions; D2.2–3 verifies materials and lifecycle. Marketplace is technical; Dashboard is business-facing.

④ 推进方式与下一门④ Delivery and next gate

价值基线、成本、风险与复用证据支持继续、缩小、补证或转交。七阶段是路径，不是第一天完成承诺：D1.5 初填 → D2.5 统一建议 → D2.6 决策状态与行动。Value baseline, cost, risk and reuse evidence support continuing, narrowing, adding proof or hand-off. Seven stages are a path, not a Day 1 completion promise: D1.5 → D2.5 proposal → D2.6 decision/actions.

讨论焦点Discussion哪些风险已有证据和 Owner，哪些必须带入实施与第二天补证？Which risks have evidence and owners, and which need proof during implementation planning and Day 2?

ISS 最佳实践：业务轴与功能轴ISS Best Practice: Two Axes

先从 ISS 已有业务、知识与 Agent 找到真实场景，再用功能分类识别跨场景复用；本轮不预锁 BO。Start with ISS business, knowledge and Agents, then classify reusable capabilities. BO is not pre-selected.

业务分类轴Business axis

  • 业务链、部门/角色、服务对象与用户旅程
  • 流程节点、区域、价值指标与明确 Owner
  • Business chain, roles, users and journey
  • Process nodes, region, value measure and Owner

  • 问答/检索、知识采集、数据分析、页面生成
  • 规则判断、预测/优化、Workflow、后台执行与异常处理
  • Q&A/retrieval, knowledge capture, analytics and page generation
  • Rules, prediction/optimization, Workflow, execution and exception handling

候选筛选条件Candidate screen

价值、数据与知识可得性、规则稳定性、风险、复杂度、评测条件、维护责任、复用潜力。

Value, data and knowledge access, rule stability, risk, complexity, evaluation, maintenance and reuse.

先有材料，再有清单Evidence before shortlist

UKM、PEI、BO、CEC、eSVC、物流或 Field Service 仅作候选入口；名称和范围需确认。

UKM, PEI, BO, CEC, , eSVC, logistics or Field Service are entry points only; names and scope need confirmation.

090 · MD §D1.5.1 · ISS实施输入ISS implementation inputs
MD §D1.5.1 · 流程重塑

AI 重塑流程，而不只是增加聊天入口Reform the Process, Not Just the Chat Entry

从目标结果倒推业务过程：保留必要步骤，消除重复操作，减少交接，并把人机边界写进流程。Work backward from the outcome: retain necessary steps, remove repetition, reduce handoffs and define human control.

01 · 目标

先定义结果、对象与可验证阶段目标。

Define the outcome, user and verifiable milestone.

02 · 重排

决定保留、消除、后台运行或合并的步骤。

Decide what to retain, remove, run in background or merge.

03 · 分工

划分自动、辅助、人工确认和接管。

Separate automatic, assisted, human confirmation and takeover.

04 · 闭环

连接信息、决策、执行、反馈与责任。

Connect information, decisions, actions, feedback and ownership.

必须一起检查Check together

  • 上下游责任、系统限制与合规约束
  • 关键状态、Action、异常路径和人工接管
  • Upstream/downstream ownership, system limits and compliance
  • States, Actions, exceptions and human takeover

应形成的工作输出Working outputs

目标流程、现状—目标差异、任务分工、关键状态与可验证阶段目标；不承诺一次改造所有系统。

Target flow, current-to-target gaps, task split, states and milestones; no promise to transform every system at once.

092 · MD §D1.5.1 · ISS实施输入ISS implementation inputs
MD §D1.5.1 · 协作边界

三部门共建，DT 按需支撑Three-Way Build, DT as Needed

业务 Owner、直接能力团队与工程交付各自负责；数据、代码、接口和安全支持按需进入，不把未确认能力当作交付。Business ownership, direct capability support and engineering delivery stay distinct; DT supports when needed, and unknown capabilities are not treated as delivered.

参与方主要责任
ISS Biz (team)场景、流程、规则、专家、数据定义、验收、采用与价值验证。
COO AI TeamITEM 直接对接；Hollis 方法、已有成果、模型/底座与治理支撑。
ITEMFDE 协作、Agent/Workflow/页面工程、编排、测试、产品化与交付。
DT/IT/Security数据、源代码、软件、接口、基础设施、安全与认证，按需支撑。
PartyPrimary responsibility
ISS Biz (team)Scenario, process, rules, experts, data definition, acceptance, adoption and value.
COO AI TeamDirect ITEM interface; Hollis method, existing results, models/base and governance.
ITEMFDE collaboration, Agent/Workflow/page engineering, orchestration, testing and delivery.
DT/IT/SecurityData, source, software, interfaces, infrastructure, security and certification as needed.

每个场景的责任字段Required fields per scenario

  • 三方 Owner、FDE、专家审核人
  • 系统与数据责任人、审批人、运营维护人
  • 人员可兼任，但责任字段不能缺失
  • Three-party Owners, FDE and expert reviewer
  • System/data, approval and operations owners
  • People may wear multiple hats; fields cannot be blank

边界：业务规则与价值判断不能全部交给 IT 或 AI；ITEM 不能绕过企业权限、审核和生产要求。

Boundary: business rules and value judgment stay with the business; ITEM cannot bypass permissions, review or production controls.

讨论焦点Discussion首个场景的六类责任人由谁填写、谁确认？Who fills and confirms the six responsibility fields for the first scenario?

MD §D1.5.1 · 七阶段 1/7

阶段一：知识挖掘与最佳实践识别Phase 1: Discover Knowledge & Practice

先建立共同事实：按业务轴与功能轴盘点材料、流程断点和候选场景，再决定是否进入共建。Build a shared fact base: inventory materials, breakpoints and candidates by business and capability axes before co-building.

输入Inputs

  • Ticket、UKM/WIKI、代码、数据、视频、SOP、已有 Agent
  • 业务流程、用户、Owner 与现有痛点
  • Tickets, UKM/WIKI, code, data, video, SOPs and existing Agents
  • Business process, users, Owners and known pain points

工作输出Work outputs

  • Business Knowledge Map、Process Breakpoint Map
  • 候选优先级、初版规则/本体范围
  • Business Knowledge Map and Process Breakpoint Map
  • Candidate priorities and initial rule/ontology scope

验收门Acceptance gate

场景、业务 Owner 和问题边界已确认；否则停留在盘点，不进入下一阶段。

Scenario, business Owner and problem boundary are confirmed; otherwise remain in discovery.

本轮边界This round

不承诺完成全部盘点；先选可取得材料的范围，记录缺口和后续责任。

No promise to complete the full inventory; select an accessible scope and record gaps and owners.

阶段二：能力基座准备Phase 2: Prepare the Capability Base

把真实场景需要的资料、能力、权限与环境列清，区分已有、缺失和需开发项。Make the required materials, capabilities, access and environment explicit; separate existing, missing and to-build items.

输入Inputs

  • 阶段一确认的场景、流程、规则与材料
  • 数据、知识、代码、模型、算力、Connector/Tools
  • Phase 1 scenario, process, rules and materials

关键输入可访问、权限责任可追溯、测试环境与日志/评测路径明确。

A catalog is not production readiness; gaps go into the decision record with an owner.

以首个场景做小范围真实流程验证，先明确 Action 边界，再决定是否扩大。Validate a real flow in a narrow first scenario, define Action boundaries, then decide whether to expand.

阶段四：Training 与普及Phase 4: Training & Adoption

Training 不只是用户演示：业务要会运行与反馈，专业人员要会建模、测试、发布与维护。Training goes beyond demos: users learn to run and give feedback; specialists learn to model, test, release and maintain.

输入Inputs

  • 已验证的流程、Agent/Workflow 与失败边界
  • 用户角色、FDE/Senior User/Developer 和 DT 支撑需求
  • Validated flow, Agent/Workflow and failure boundaries
  • User roles, FDE/Senior User/Developer and DT needs

工作输出Work outputs

  • 用户培训、使用材料、反馈路径
  • 运营责任、采用计划，以及何时确认或接管
  • User training, usage material and feedback path
  • Operations ownership, adoption plan and takeover rules

验收门Acceptance gate

用户知道何时使用、确认、拒答或接管；运营责任已有人签认。

Users know when to use, confirm, reject or take over; operations ownership is signed off.

本轮边界This round

不承诺全员培训或全面采用；采用计划取决于验证结果和责任确认。

No promise of universal training or adoption; the plan depends on validation and ownership.

阶段五：优化与垂直深耕Phase 5: Optimize & Deepen

从可运行走向更稳健：扩展规则和样本，检验泛化，优化上下文、路由、成本与多 Agent 协作。Move from running to robust: expand rules and samples, test generalization, and improve context, routing, cost and collaboration.

输入Inputs

  • 已验证版本、失败清单、反馈和回归样本
  • 新增规则、场景、模型/路由与成本信息
  • Validated version, failures, feedback and regression samples
  • New rules, scenarios, model/routing and cost data

工作输出Work outputs

  • 版本迭代、回归评测、质量/成本/价值报告
  • 泛化测试、预测/优化与多 Agent 协作方案
  • Version iterations, regression evaluation and quality/cost/value report
  • Generalization tests, prediction/optimization and multi-Agent options

验收门Acceptance gate

扩展后通过约定回归门；新增范围、风险和责任重新确认。

The expanded scope passes the agreed regression gate; risk and ownership are reconfirmed.

本轮边界This round

不把优化方向当作已实现收益；每次扩展都要有样本、版本和继续/停止条件。

Optimization directions are not realized benefits; every expansion needs samples, versioning and continue/stop criteria.

先在内部区域/业务复制，满足条件后再讨论 Genesys Marketplace、服务/供应链客户与联合推广。Replicate internally first; discuss Marketplace, service/supply-chain customers and joint promotion only when conditions are met.

MD §D1.5.1 · Day 1 · 输出与衔接

Day 1 输出：候选、材料、能力缺口与第二天输入Day 1 output: candidates, evidence, gaps and Day 2 inputs

第一天形成可核验的初步判断；第二天是独立完整议程，用真实业务与企业能力继续深化，不是可选延伸。Day 1 forms a verifiable first view; Day 2 is a separate full agenda to deepen with real business and enterprise capability, not an optional extension.

01 · 选定候选01 · Select a candidate

  • 按业务轴与功能轴整理一个候选场景，写清用户、流程断点、范围与排除项。
  • 不预先锁定 BO 或某个 Agent 名称。
  • Classify one candidate by business and capability axes; state users, breakpoints, scope and exclusions.
  • Do not pre-lock BO or an Agent name.

02 · 取得真实材料02 · Secure real evidence

  • 取一组可授权材料：ticket、WIKI/UKM、代码、数据、视频、SOP 或已有 Agent。
  • 标明来源、版本、专家与可共享范围。
  • Bring an authorized set of tickets, WIKI/UKM, code, data, video, SOPs or existing Agents.
  • Record provenance, version, expert and sharing scope.

03 · 补齐能力与流程03 · Map capability and flow

  • 确认规则、样本、数据/代码/知识/模型/接口/环境及权限可得性。
  • 起草小本体或 SOP/Workflow，区分自动、辅助、人工确认与模拟。
  • Confirm rules, samples, data/code/knowledge/models/interfaces/environments and access.
  • Draft a small ontology or SOP/Workflow; separate automatic, assisted, human-confirmed and simulated work.

04 · 带入第二天04 · Carry into Day 2

形成能力缺口、风险、责任、首轮交付边界、评测要求与下一门；D2.1–D2.4 分别深化实践、业务域、资产和组织衔接，D2.5 统一建议，D2.6 决策确认。

Carry capability gaps, risks, owners, first-delivery boundaries, evaluation needs and the next gate into D2.1–D2.4; D2.5 unifies the recommendation and D2.6 confirms the decision.

讨论焦点Discussion今天结束时，哪项材料和哪位 Owner 能让第二天从证据开始，而不是重新介绍平台？By the end of today, which evidence and Owner let Day 2 start from facts rather than repeat the platform introduction?

101 · MD §D1.5.1 · ISS实施输入ISS implementation inputs
MD §D1.5.1 · Day 1 · 长期优势

长期优势来自语义、验证与可持续交付Durable advantage comes from semantics, proof and sustainable delivery

优势不等于 Agent 数量、模型归属或某一个聊天入口，而是能否持续产生可靠结果、降低重复建设并加快跨场景交付。Advantage is not Agent count, model ownership or one chat entry; it is the ability to deliver reliable results, reduce duplicate build and move faster across scenarios.

共同语义Shared semantics

  • 业务对象、关系、状态、规则与 Action 可被业务和工程共同理解。
  • 同一语义支撑知识、页面、Workflow 与业务结果。
  • Business objects, relations, states, rules and Actions are understood by business and engineering.
  • One semantic base supports knowledge, pages, Workflows and outcomes.

专家知识与标准行动Expert knowledge and standard Actions

  • 知识、规则、例外和责任经专家审核，带来源、版本与有效期。
  • 连接器、Tools、Skill 和 Action 可授权、测试、观测、回写与复用。
  • Knowledge, rules, exceptions and ownership are expert-reviewed with source, version and validity.
  • Connectors, Tools, Skills and Actions are authorized, tested, observed, written back and reused.

稳定评测与可持续工程Stable evaluation and sustainable engineering

  • 独立样本、失败分类、回归门与业务基线持续验证，而不是模型自评。
  • 版本、部署、成本、维护、回滚和质量反馈形成闭环。
  • Independent samples, failure classes, regression gates and business baselines persist beyond self-rating.
  • Versioning, deployment, cost, maintenance, rollback and quality feedback form a loop.

组织的长期优势Organizational advantage

ISS Biz 定义业务与价值，COO AI Team 提供能力与治理，ITEM 负责应用工程；FDE、专家、审批、运营及 DT 按需协同，持续把证据沉淀为可复制交付。

ISS Biz owns business and value, COO AI Team provides capability and governance, and ITEM delivers application engineering; FDEs, experts, approvers, operations and DT collaborate as needed.

讨论焦点Discussion哪个已验证语义、评测闭环或组织机制，能在多个业务场景重复产生价值？Which proven semantic base, evaluation loop or organizational mechanism can create value across multiple scenarios?

102 · MD §D1.5.2 · ISS实施输入ISS implementation inputs
MD §D1.5.2 · Day 1 · 10 min（含于60 min）

Day 1 阶段性收敛：初步填写四个决策字段Day 1 convergence: first pass on four decision fields

Tom 主持 10 分钟初填同一份记录，区分已知、候选建议与待补证据；第二天持续补齐，D2.5 统一建议，D2.6 确认推进状态。Tom hosts a 10-minute first pass in the same record, separating known, candidate and evidence-needed items; Day 2 fills it, D2.5 unifies the recommendation and D2.6 confirms status.

① 首个共建场景与验收指标① First co-build scene and acceptance

场景：候选；问题/用户：已知或待补；范围/排除项：候选；基线、样本、指标、测试与验收：待补证据。

Scene: candidate; problem/users: known or missing; scope/exclusions: candidate; baseline, samples, metrics, tests and acceptance: evidence needed.

状态：候选建议＋待补证据，不写成已批准。

Status: candidate + evidence needed; not approved.

② 联合团队与 Owner② Joint team and Owners

ISS Biz 业务 Owner；COO AI 能力 Owner；ITEM 交付 Owner；FDE、专家、数据/系统、审批、运营与 DT 按需角色：待确认。

ISS Biz business Owner; COO AI capability Owner; ITEM delivery Owner; FDE, expert, data/system, approval, operations and DT-as-needed roles: to confirm.

状态：已知角色框架，姓名与责任人待补证据。

Status: role framework known; names and owners need evidence.

③ 能力输入与执行边界③ Inputs and execution boundary

已有材料/能力、缺口、权限、部署、日志、留存、评测；分别标记真实执行、模拟、人工确认与不可执行。

Mark available inputs/capabilities, gaps, access, deployment, logs, retention and evaluation; separate real execution, simulation, human confirmation and cannot execute.

状态：候选清单，接口、权限与环境待补证据。

Status: candidate inventory; interfaces, access and environment need evidence.

④ 推进方式与下一决策门④ Delivery path and next gate

首轮阶段、交付物、Owner、投入、时间、继续/调整/停止条件与后续阶段：待会议确认。

First stage, deliverables, Owner, investment, timing, continue/adjust/stop conditions and later stages: confirm in session.

D2.5：形成统一建议；D2.6：确认状态、条件、Owner、日期与下一评审。

D2.5: unified recommendation; D2.6: confirm status, conditions, Owners, dates and next review.

主持人提示Facilitator prompt四字段只记录当前证据和缺口；会议共识不替代安全、EA/BIA、预算、数据/模型授权或生产审批。Record evidence and gaps only; meeting consensus does not replace security, EA/BIA, budget, data/model authorization or production approval.

103 · MD §day2 · 目标蓝图Target blueprint
DAY 2 · ISS AI Native 转型工作坊 · R5DAY 2 · ISS AI Native transformation workshop · R5

从目标运营蓝图到联合实施From target operating blueprint to joint implementation

第二天不重播第一天的平台与案例；用企业实践、ISS材料和共同记录，形成蓝图、差距、路线、产品化与决策收敛。Day 2 does not replay Day 1 platforms or cases; it uses enterprise practice, ISS material and one shared record to converge blueprint, gaps, roadmap, productization and decisions.

01 · 目标蓝图 · 120 min01 · Target blueprint · 120 min

Hollis 60分钟包含在内；共同设计未来2–3年如何运营、协作和沉淀能力。Includes Hollis’s 60 minutes; co-design how ISS operates, collaborates and builds capability over 2–3 years.

02 · 差距与突破 · 90 min02 · Gaps & breakthroughs · 90 min

六域材料会前表单采集；会中按跨域断点、共同能力和突破任务讨论。Six-domain material is collected before the workshop; discuss cross-domain breaks, shared capability and breakthrough tasks.

03 · 路线与动手 · 120 min03 · Roadmap & hands-on · 120 min

业务、组织、平台、产品四条泳道；45–60分钟完成小范围草稿，不承诺上线。Four lanes for business, organization, platform and product; 45–60 minutes for a small draft, no launch promise.

04 · 自主能力/IP/商业化 · 90 min04 · Capability/IP/commercialization · 90 min

把实践、案例与ISS材料汇成目标工作方式；这是待共创的规划，不是现状评分或上线承诺。Combine practice, cases and ISS evidence into a target way of working; this is a co-created plan, not a maturity score or launch promise.

01 · OPERATING CHAIN

从任务到反馈From task to feedback

  • 一线接任务、补上下文、用建议或受控Action。
  • 缺失、冲突和高风险动作进入人工确认/升级。
  • 结果、状态与运行反馈回到业务和能力资产。
  • Frontline teams receive tasks, add context and use advice or governed Actions.
  • Missing, conflicting or high-risk cases go to human confirmation or escalation.
  • Outcomes, states and runtime feedback return to business and capability assets.
02 · COMMON ASSETS

可复用但可追踪Reusable and traceable

  • 知识、规则、流程、Skill、接口、评测和反馈有版本、权限与Owner。
  • 跨域复用前重新确认语义、权限与验收。
  • 没有证据的目标只登记为待验证问题。
  • Knowledge, rules, processes, Skills, interfaces, evaluation and feedback have versions, access and Owners.
  • Revalidate semantics, access and acceptance before cross-domain reuse.
  • Goals without evidence remain validation questions.
03 · PEOPLE & PRODUCT

组织运行与近期并行People, product and near-term parallel work

  • 专家维护规则，主管看质量/成本/服务结果，跨域Owner推动复用。
  • 近期同步盘点可授权IP、候选客户问题与可重复交付结构。
  • Experts maintain rules; supervisors watch quality, cost and service outcomes; cross-domain Owners drive reuse.
  • In parallel now, identify licensable IP, candidate customer problems and repeatable delivery structures.

DAY 2 · MD §D2.1.2 · R5

一线、专家、主管与跨域工作方式How frontline, experts, supervisors and domains work

目标蓝图必须落到日常任务、审核、运营和跨域复用；人员、权限和指标未确认时保留为待补证。The blueprint must reach daily tasks, review, operations and cross-domain reuse; unconfirmed people, access and metrics stay as evidence gaps.

FRONTLINE

一线Frontline

  • 接收任务并补上下文。
  • 使用建议/流程，确认允许动作。
  • 缺失或冲突时拒答、转人工、升级。
  • Receive tasks and add context.
  • Use advice/workflows and confirm allowed actions.
  • Refuse, hand off or escalate missing/conflicting cases.
EXPERT

专家Experts

  • 维护术语、规则、例外和SOP。
  • 审核业务变更、样本与验收口径。
  • 让错误回到知识/规则/流程。
  • Maintain terms, rules, exceptions and SOPs.
  • Review changes, samples and acceptance definitions.
  • Feed errors back to knowledge, rules and process.
SUPERVISOR

主管Supervisors

  • 看质量、周期、成本、风险、采用和结果。
  • 按证据决定继续、调整、缩小或退出。
  • 不以调用量替代业务价值。
  • Watch quality, cycle, cost, risk, adoption and outcomes.
  • Use evidence to continue, adjust, narrow or retire.
  • Do not equate call volume with value.
CROSS-DOMAIN

跨域协作Cross-domain

  • ISS Biz负责目标、规则、采用和验收。
  • COO AI/ITEM共同开发，DT按需支撑。
  • 复用前重验语义、权限和验收。
  • ISS Biz owns goals, rules, adoption and acceptance.
  • COO AI and ITEM co-develop; DT supports as needed.
  • Revalidate semantics, access and acceptance before reuse.

MD §D2.1.4–D2.1.5 · 60 min · R5

业务 AI 要素如何连接成体系Connecting the elements of business AI

Hollis 分享业务 know-how 如何穿过流程、数据、模型、IT 和反馈，成为可评估、可复用、可进化的能力。Hollis shares how business know-how crosses process, data, models, IT and feedback to become evaluable, reusable and evolving capability.

01 · BUSINESS

目标与流程Goal & process

把目标、用户、步骤、规则、例外、价值指标写成可讨论的业务事实。Make goals, users, steps, rules, exceptions and value metrics discussable business facts.

02 · EVIDENCE

样本与专家Samples & experts

用正常、异常、边界样本和专家判断，区分回答、分类、预测、优化与执行。Use normal, abnormal and boundary samples plus expert judgment to distinguish answer, classify, predict, optimize and execute.

03 · CAPABILITY

Skill / Workflow / ModelSkill / Workflow / Model

从可追踪版本、权限和评测出发，形成候选 Skill、Workflow、模型或 Agent；不是自动上线。Start from traceable versions, access and evaluation to form candidate Skills, Workflows, models or Agents—not automatic release.

04 · IT LOOP

运行与反馈Runtime feedback

身份、接口、日志、成本、人工接管和结果反馈，决定能力能否受控运行。Identity, interfaces, logs, cost, human takeover and outcome feedback determine whether capability can run under control.

讨论焦点DiscussionHollis 可分享哪些已验证方法与证据？哪些只作为 ISS 的待验证参考，不外推为既有能力？Which validated methods and evidence can Hollis share? Which remain ISS references to validate, not assumed capabilities?

108 · MD §D2.1.12 / D2.1.14 · 目标蓝图Target blueprint
MD §D2.1.5–D2.1.7 · 60 min · R5

从项目经验到可复制、可进化的能力 From project experience to evolving capability

“可复制”不是搬运一个 Agent，而是复制证据结构，再按业务规则、数据、权限和 Owner 重新验证。 “Reusable” does not mean moving an Agent; it means reusing the evidence structure and revalidating rules, data, access and ownership.

01 · CAPTURE

沉淀Capture

  • 记录流程、判断、例外、失败与价值。
  • 保留来源、版本、专家和人工边界。
  • Record process, judgment, exceptions, failures and value.
  • Keep source, version, expert and human boundary.
02 · REUSE

复制Reuse

  • 复用方法、字段、评测方式和接口契约。
  • 不复用未经确认的业务规则或权限。
  • Reuse methods, fields, evaluation and interface contracts.
  • Do not reuse unconfirmed rules or access.
03 · EVOLVE

进化Evolve

  • 用反馈、漂移、错误和新规则触发版本。
  • 回归样本、批准和回滚必须可追踪。
  • Use feedback, drift, errors and new rules to trigger versions.
  • Regression samples, approval and rollback must be traceable.
04 · PROVE

证据Prove

  • 输出可验证做法、前提、证据和不可外推项。
  • 材料不足时，输出问题与依赖而非成熟度结论。
  • Output validated practice, assumptions, evidence and non-transferable claims.
  • When material is missing, output questions and dependencies—not maturity claims.
现场输出Room output 形成“可复用 / 需共同开发 / 需 DT 支撑 / 待确认”清单；不承诺 ISS 已具备 Hollis 所述成果。 Create a reusable / co-build / DT support / to-confirm list; do not claim ISS already has Hollis’s results.

MD §D2.2.2 · 六域共同模板

六个业务域使用同一套事实与价值模板One fact-and-value template for six domains

共同模板约束讨论顺序；每域必须用真实材料回答，不能用工具名称替代业务事实，也不能把待确认写成现状。The common template constrains the order of inquiry; every domain uses real material, not tool names or assumptions.

01 · FACT

目标 / 用户 / 现状Goal / user / current state

谁在什么节点遇到什么问题？流程、工单、SOP、页面和已有处理如何工作？输出基线与断点。Who has what problem at which step? How do process, tickets, SOPs, pages and current handling work? Output baseline and breakpoints.

02 · RULE

知识 / 规则Knowledge / rules

定义、版本、有效期、例外和专家判断来自哪里？输出候选知识、审核人和缺口。Where do definitions, versions, validity, exceptions and expert judgment come from? Output candidates, reviewer and gaps.

03 · CAPABILITY

数据 / 执行边界Data / execution boundary

所需数据、代码、模型、接口、Tools、Skill、Action 是什么？质量、权限和人工点如何确认？What data, code, models, interfaces, Tools, Skills and Actions are needed? How are quality, access and human points confirmed?

04 · VALUE

价值 / 评测 / 决策Value / evaluation / decision

用基线、独立样本、质量/周期/成本/风险/采用指标和接管点，形成 Owner、依赖与下一门。Use baseline, independent samples, quality/cycle/cost/risk/adoption metrics and takeover points to form Owner, dependencies and next gate.

EVIDENCE STATUS

四种状态，不做成熟度排名Four states, no maturity ranking

  • 已常态运行：有来源、版本、Owner和核验日期。
  • 局部试点：范围、样本、结果和限制写清。
  • 尚未形成：材料支持缺口判断，但不推断能力不存在。
  • 待补证：需材料、专家、授权、接口或正式审批。
  • Established: source, version, Owner and verification date exist.
  • Local pilot: scope, samples, results and limits are explicit.
  • Not yet formed: evidence supports a gap, not a claim of absence.
  • Evidence gap: needs material, expert, access, interface or approval.

业务、组织、平台、产品四条路线泳道Four roadmap lanes: business, organization, platform, product

0–3 / 3–12 / 12–24 / 24–36月是规划窗口；四条路线并行，产品/IP近期启动验证。0–3 / 3–12 / 12–24 / 24–36 months are planning windows; all four lanes run in parallel, with product/IP validation starting now.

BUSINESS

业务流程与价值Process & value

  • 0–3：首范围、基线、样本、人工边界。
  • 3–12：进入可维护流程并看结果。
  • 12–36：复制已验证流程，按证据扩展。
  • 0–3: scope, baseline, samples, human boundary.
  • 3–12: move into maintainable flow and observe outcomes.
  • 12–36: replicate proven flows and scale by evidence.
ORGANIZATION

组织与人才机制Organization & talent

  • 0–3：明确三方、FDE、专家、审批、运营。
  • 3–12：建立变更、评测、培训、故障机制。
  • 12–36：形成跨域Owner与维护能力。
  • 0–3: clarify partners, FDE, experts, approval and operations.
  • 3–12: establish change, evaluation, training and incident routines.
  • 12–36: build cross-domain Owners and maintenance capability.
PLATFORM

平台与能力资产Platform & assets

  • 0–3：盘点输入并建能力卡、权限、评测、日志最小集。
  • 3–12：标准接入、观测、回归、退出。
  • 12–36：积累语义、反馈和评测资产。
  • 0–3: inventory inputs; minimum cards, access, evaluation and logs.
  • 3–12: standard access, observation, regression and retirement.
  • 12–36: build semantic, feedback and evaluation assets.
PRODUCT

产品与商业化Product & commercialization

  • 0–3：权利盘点、客户问题、产品假设和验证方案。
  • 3–12：有限客户/场景验证与可重复交付包。
  • 12–36：依据市场证据扩展；不把内部有效直接外推。
  • 0–3: rights, customer problem, product hypothesis and validation.
  • 3–12: limited customer/scenario validation and repeatable package.
  • 12–36: scale by market evidence; do not extrapolate internal success.

授权材料动手共建：45–60分钟Hands-on co-build with authorized material: 45–60 minutes

嵌入D2.3的120分钟；完成小范围草稿、能力卡、验收与下一步，不承诺生产上线或认证。Embedded in D2.3’s 120 minutes; produce a small draft, capability card, acceptance and next step—no production launch or certification promise.

01 · SCOPE

范围与角色Scope & roles

  • 5–10分钟：授权SOP/脱敏样本、目标流程、排除项。
  • 确认ISS Biz、专家、ITEM/FDE、COO AI及按需DT。
  • 无授权材料则切换离线样例/回放。
  • 5–10 min: authorized SOP/redacted samples, target flow, exclusions.
  • Confirm ISS Biz, expert, ITEM/FDE, COO AI and DT as needed.
  • Use an offline sample/replay if material is unavailable.
02 · FLOW DRAFT

流程草稿Flow draft

  • 10–15分钟：画步骤、输入、判断、例外和结果。
  • 标自动、辅助、人工确认、拒答/升级与停止。
  • 10–15 min: map steps, inputs, judgment, exceptions and outcome.
  • Mark automation, assistance, human confirmation, refusal/escalation and stop.
03 · CARD & TEST

能力卡与验收Card & acceptance

  • 10–15分钟：填来源、输入输出、权限、版本、依赖、Owner。
  • 用正常/异常/边界样本区分建议、Action调用与业务结果。
  • 10–15 min: capture source, I/O, access, version, dependencies and Owner.
  • Use normal, abnormal and boundary samples to separate advice, Action call and business outcome.
04 · NEXT GATE

下一步而非上线Next step, not launch

  • 5分钟：补证据、责任人、日期、投入、审批路径。
  • 选择继续/有条件继续/补证缩小/暂缓转交。
  • 不足时缩小或停止，不强行产品化。
  • 5 min: evidence, Owner, date, effort and approval path.
  • Choose continue / conditional / narrow for evidence / pause-transfer.
  • Narrow or stop when weak; do not force productization.

MD §D2.3.4 · 能力资产 · R5

将经验沉淀为知识、流程、数据、模型与评测资产Turn experience into governed capability assets

资产来自真实流程和审核；技术 Marketplace 服务发现、接口、元数据、版本、权限与认证，Dashboard 面向人员和管理者呈现运行与价值。Assets come from real process and review; the technical Marketplace serves discovery, interfaces, metadata, versions, access and certification, while Dashboard serves people and managers.

KNOWLEDGE / PROCESS

知识与流程Knowledge & process

定义、SOP、规则、例外、版本、审核意见和可执行步骤；保留来源与适用范围。Definitions, SOPs, rules, exceptions, versions, review and executable steps; retain source and scope.

DATA / MODEL

数据与模型Data & model

数据字典、样本、权限、质量、模型/参数、输入输出和错误边界；不把模型名称当成果。Data dictionaries, samples, access, quality, model/parameters, I/O and error boundaries; a model name is not an outcome.

SKILL / AGENT / WORKFLOW

可执行能力Executable capability

Skill、Agent、Workflow 或应用能力须有触发、权限、Action、人工接管、日志与回滚边界。Skills, Agents, Workflows or applications need triggers, access, Actions, human takeover, logs and rollback boundaries.

MARKETPLACE / DASHBOARD

两种工作面Two working surfaces

Marketplace 是技术能力层；Dashboard 是人员业务层。两者都依赖版本、Owner、评测、成本和风险证据。Marketplace is the technical capability layer; Dashboard is the people/business layer. Both depend on evidence for version, Owner, evaluation, cost and risk.

04 · REGISTERED
登记认证Registration & certification
  • 补齐权限、接口、成本、部署、日志、版本、责任与回滚。
  • 交付：能力卡与认证结论；未满足项保持待确认。
  • Complete access, interfaces, cost, deployment, logs, version, accountability and rollback.
  • Output: capability card and certification conclusion; open items stay to confirm.

124 · MD §D2.3.12 · 实施路线图Implementation roadmap
MD §D2.3.5 · Day 2 · R5

能力生命周期 II：发布 → 观测 → 回归 → 退出Lifecycle II: Run to Retire

登记认证之后仍要持续证明价值、质量与边界；发布不是终点，退出也不是失败。After registration, an asset must keep proving value, quality and boundaries; release is not the finish line, and retirement is not failure.

01 · RELEASE / 发布接入

可调用、可追踪Callable and traceable

授权进入目录或 Marketplace，锁定发布版本、调用方、API/Tool 元数据与执行边界。

Authorize the directory or Marketplace entry; lock release version, callers, API/Tool metadata and execution boundaries.

02 · OBSERVE / 运行观测

看采用，也看结果Observe outcomes

同时观察采用、质量、异常、成本、人工介入和业务结果；日志进入 Dashboard。

Observe adoption, quality, exceptions, cost, human intervention and business outcomes; feed logs to the Dashboard.

03 · REGRESS / 回归版本

变化先回归Regress before change

知识、规则、模型、接口或业务变化时，记录差异、回归结果、批准与回滚路径。

When knowledge, rules, models, interfaces or business change, record differences, regression, approval and rollback.

04 · RETIRE / 退出替换

有理由地撤销Retire with reason

低价值、过时、无 Owner、风险过高或被替代时，保留影响、替代和撤销记录。

When value falls, ownership disappears, risk rises or a replacement exists, retain impact, replacement and revocation records.

连续证据：每次状态变化都要带版本、Owner、权限、测评与可回退信息。Continuous evidence: every state change carries version, Owner, access, evaluation and rollback information.

MD §D2.3.3 · Day 2

能力卡、技术 Marketplace 与业务 DashboardAsset Card, Marketplace and Dashboard

同一项能力需要两种工作面：技术 Marketplace 管“能否被正确调用”，业务 Dashboard 管“是否产生正确结果”。One capability needs two work surfaces: the technical Marketplace governs correct invocation; the business Dashboard governs useful outcomes.

TECHNICAL LAYER · MARKETPLACE

能力卡最小技术字段Minimum technical fields

  • 知识状态、版本、Owner、测评与回归结果
  • 权限、API/Tool 元数据、部署、依赖与成本
  • 日志、留存、回滚、退出条件与授权范围
  • Knowledge state, version, Owner, evaluation and regression
  • Access, API/Tool metadata, deployment, dependencies and cost
  • Logs, retention, rollback, retirement and authorization scope

BUSINESS LAYER · DASHBOARD

人员与管理者要看什么What people and managers see

  • 采用、质量、异常、人工介入与业务价值
  • 成本、风险、反馈、责任人与当前版本
  • 把事实、推测/合成样本与待确认状态分开
  • Adoption, quality, exceptions, intervention and business value
  • Cost, risk, feedback, accountable Owner and current version
  • Separate facts, inferred/synthetic samples and pending confirmation
边界：Marketplace 是技术能力层，不等于业务授权；Dashboard 是人员业务层，不替代正式审批。Boundary: Marketplace is the technical capability layer, not business authorization; the business Dashboard is not formal approval.

126 · MD §D2.3.13 / D2.3.14 · 实施路线图Implementation roadmap
MD §D2.3.3–D2.3.4 · Day 2

持续复用与版本进化，不是一刀切搬迁Reuse and Evolve, Do Not Migrate Blindly

先把已有 Agent、模型、代码和环境登记清楚，再按成熟度选择复用、适配或服务化；七阶段项目路径不是资产生命周期。Register existing Agents, models, code and environments first; then choose reuse, adaptation or service based on maturity. The seven-stage project path is not the asset lifecycle.

01 · REGISTER

登记与复用Register and reuse

  • 保留来源、当前版本、Owner、边界与依赖
  • 已有能力先接入评测标准，不假设已认证
  • 可复用的输入、规则和反馈进入能力卡
  • Keep source, current version, Owner, boundaries and dependencies
  • Apply evaluation standards before assuming certification
  • Move reusable inputs, rules and feedback into the asset card

02 · ADAPT

按成熟度适配Adapt by maturity

  • 样本、权限、日志或接口不足时先缩小范围
  • 明确人工确认、拒答、升级和回滚边界
  • 只补真正缺口，不把项目交付物当资产认证
  • Narrow scope when samples, access, logs or interfaces are incomplete
  • Define human confirmation, refusal, escalation and rollback
  • Fill real gaps; project delivery is not asset certification

03 · EVOLVE

版本进化与复制Evolve and replicate

  • 知识、规则、模型、接口变化触发回归
  • 成熟后再服务化或复制到相邻业务
  • 每次扩展保留差异、批准与退出条件
  • Knowledge, rule, model or interface changes trigger regression
  • Service-ify or replicate only after maturity
  • Keep differences, approval and retirement conditions
两条线并行：七阶段项目管理交付节奏；能力资产生命周期管理长期可用性。Two tracks: the seven-stage project path manages delivery; the asset lifecycle manages long-term usability.

MD §D2.4.1 · Day 2

AI 原生：重排信息、决策、执行与责任AI-Native: Rewire Work and Accountability

AI 原生不是增加聊天入口，而是围绕业务结果重新组织信息流、判断点、执行动作、反馈和责任。AI-native work is not another chat entry; it reorganizes information, decisions, actions, feedback and accountability around outcomes.

01 · INFORMATION

信息可用Useful information

  • 业务事实、规则、知识与来源可追踪
  • 原始记录、AI 提取、SOP 草稿、审核分层
  • Traceable business facts, rules, knowledge and sources
  • Separate raw records, AI extraction, SOP drafts and review

02 · DECISION

判断有边界Bounded decisions

  • 标记规则、例外、拒答、升级和人工确认
  • Agent 不自行扩权限，不把建议写成批准
  • Mark rules, exceptions, refusal, escalation and human confirmation
  • Agents do not expand access or turn advice into approval

03 · EXECUTION

执行可控Controlled execution

  • Action、系统回写、权限和停止条件可查
  • 高风险动作保留人确认与正式审批
  • Trace actions, write-back, access and stop conditions
  • Keep human confirmation and formal approval for high risk

04 · FEEDBACK

反馈回到能力Feedback into capability

  • 观测采用、质量、成本、风险和业务结果
  • 反馈触发训练、版本、回归或退出
  • Observe adoption, quality, cost, risk and business outcomes
  • Feedback triggers training, versioning, regression or retirement
组织原则：ISS Biz 保留业务规则与价值判断；技术团队负责实现与治理协同，不替代业务 Owner。Operating principle: ISS Biz keeps business rules and value judgment; technical teams implement and coordinate governance without replacing the business Owner.

129 · MD §D2.3.23 · 实施路线图Implementation roadmap
MD §D2.4.3 · Day 2

Training、采用、反馈、运维与退出责任Training, Adoption, Operations and Exit

能力交付之后，用户采用、知识更新、告警、成本、版本和退出必须有明确责任，不把 Training 当作上线认证。After delivery, adoption, knowledge updates, alerts, cost, versions and retirement need named accountability; Training is not launch certification.

TRAINING · ADOPTION

让人会用，也会反馈Enable use and feedback

  • Training 对应角色、流程、边界和转人工方式
  • 记录采用、误用、反馈与待补知识
  • 专家确认例外；人不能被默认取消
  • Train roles on process, boundaries and human handoff
  • Capture adoption, misuse, feedback and knowledge gaps
  • Experts confirm exceptions; humans are not removed by default

RUN · OBSERVE

让运行可观测Make runtime observable

  • 运维看日志、告警、容量、成本与异常
  • 业务看质量、采用、人工介入与结果
  • 规则、知识或模型变化触发回归
  • Operations watches logs, alerts, capacity, cost and incidents
  • Business watches quality, adoption, intervention and outcomes
  • Rule, knowledge or model changes trigger regression

EXIT · REPLACE

退出也要可负责Retire responsibly

  • 明确低价值、过时、无 Owner 或风险过高条件
  • 记录影响、替代、撤销、通知和回滚安排
  • 正式审批与生产变更仍按企业路径完成
  • Define low value, obsolescence, no Owner or high-risk conditions
  • Record impact, replacement, revocation, notice and rollback
  • Complete formal approval and production change separately
输出：培训/专家/运维/预算/认证缺口清单，以及每项缺口的 Owner 与证据要求。Output: a gap list for training, experts, operations, budget and certification, each with an Owner and evidence requirement.

130 · MD §D2.3.23 / D2.3.24 · 实施路线图Implementation roadmap
MD §D2.4.3–D2.4.4 · Day 2

自动、辅助、人工确认：跨业务接管与授权Automation, Assistance and Human Takeover

先按风险和动作划分接管模式，再定义跨业务 Owner、授权、升级与停止；自动化不等于自动获批。Classify takeover modes by risk and action, then define cross-business ownership, access, escalation and stop rules; automation is not approval.

AUTOMATIC · 自动

低风险、可逆动作Low-risk and reversible

  • 输入、规则、权限与停止条件清楚
  • 留日志与结果，异常自动告警
  • Inputs, rules, access and stop conditions are clear
  • Log outcomes and alert on exceptions

ASSISTED · 辅助

建议由人决定Human decides

  • Agent 生成建议、分类或候选动作
  • 业务人员确认后才进入下一步
  • Agent proposes, classifies or drafts an action
  • Business staff confirm before the next step

HUMAN CONFIRM · 人工确认

高风险保留授权Keep high-risk approval

  • 涉及外部承诺、敏感数据或不可逆动作
  • 记录确认人、依据、时间与正式审批路径
  • External commitments, sensitive data or irreversible actions
  • Record confirmer, rationale, time and formal approval path

REFUSE · ESCALATE · STOP

不会做也要可解释Refuse, escalate, stop

  • 缺证、越权、异常或超出边界时拒答
  • 转交指定 Owner，触发停止或回滚
  • Refuse when evidence, access or boundary is insufficient
  • Escalate to the named Owner; stop or roll back
授权原则：业务规则与价值判断不交给 IT；跨业务接管要有明确 Owner，且不绕过安全、EA、BIA 或生产审批。Authorization: business judgment stays with the business; cross-business takeover needs a named Owner and cannot bypass Security, EA, BIA or production approval.

131 · MD §D2.5.12 · 收敛与行动Convergence and action
MD §D2.3.1 + D2.5.2 · Day 2

四条实施泳道：近期共建、资产化与产品验证并行Four Implementation Lanes: Build, Assetize and Validate Products in Parallel

保留七阶段作为具体项目路径，同时用四条泳道管理业务、组织、平台与产品；产品化从近期准备，不拖到两年后。Keep the seven stages for project delivery while four lanes manage business, organization, platform and product; product preparation starts now, not after two years.

BUSINESS · 业务价值

0–3 月先证实Prove in 0–3 months

  • 锁定首场景、用户、基线、样本与验收
  • 正常/异常/边界流程和人工边界
  • 进入小范围验证，不假设上线
  • Lock scene, users, baseline, samples and acceptance
  • Normal, exception and boundary flow with human bounds
  • Enter narrow validation; do not assume launch

ORGANIZATION · 组织机制

Owner 与采用同步建立Build ownership and adoption

  • ISS Biz 业务 Owner；COO AI/ITEM 共建
  • 专家、FDE、Training、运维和决策人到位
  • 3–12 月形成反馈、运营与跨域复用机制
  • ISS Biz business Owner; COO AI/ITEM co-build
  • Experts, FDE, Training, operations and decision-maker
  • Build feedback, operations and reuse over 3–12 months

PLATFORM · 能力资产

可观测、可回归、可维护Observable and maintainable

  • 登记知识、规则、Skill、Workflow、接口与权限
  • 补齐评测、日志、版本、成本、回滚与退出
  • 成熟后再复制到相邻场景
  • Register knowledge, rules, Skills, Workflows, interfaces and access
  • Add evaluation, logs, versions, cost, rollback and exit
  • Replicate to adjacent scenes after maturity

PRODUCT · 产品与商业化

近期并行验证Validate in parallel

  • 定义客户问题、通用核心、配置和差异化
  • 盘点 IP/合同，准备第二场景受控复验
  • 十二月后按批准进入客户验证/试点，不等于上市
  • Define customer problem, common core, configuration and differentiation
  • Review IP/contracts and prepare a second controlled scene
  • Enter validation/pilot after December with approval; not a launch
并行关系：七阶段管理项目交付；四泳道管理两到三年转型。每条泳道都有 Owner、日期、资源、验收和下一门。Parallel tracks: seven stages manage project delivery; four lanes manage the two-to-three-year transformation. Each lane has Owner, date, resources, acceptance and next gate.

132 · MD §D2.4.1 · IP与商业化IP and commercialization
MD §D2.4.1 · Day 2MD §D2.4.1 | Day 2

自主 IP：背景资产、联合新增与授权边界Own IP: Background, Joint Additions and Rights

自主 IP 是可持续复用的业务能力组合，不等于自建模型；权利与商业化边界必须由合同和法务确认。Own IP is a reusable business capability set, not a requirement to build a model; rights and commercialization require contract and legal confirmation.

四类资产先分开Separate four asset classes

  • ITEM/COO 背景资产：既有代码、模型、框架、方法、底座、接口与品牌；记录来源、版本、授权和限制。
  • ISS 业务资产：经授权的流程、规则、领域语义、运营机制、反馈与验收方法。
  • 联合新增：共同实现的配置、Skill、Workflow、评测、连接、产品工程与运行改进。
  • 第三方授权：模型、软件、开源组件、数据、接口、客户材料与品牌条款。
  • ITEM/COO background: existing code, models, frameworks, methods, base, interfaces and brands.
  • ISS business assets: authorized processes, rules, domain semantics, operations, feedback and acceptance methods.
  • Joint additions: co-created configuration, Skills, Workflows, evaluation, connectors, product engineering and run improvements.
  • Third-party rights: models, software, open source, data, interfaces, customer materials and brands.

边界与会中记录Boundaries and meeting record

  • 共同讨论、调用或演示不自动转移背景资产所有权。
  • 客户/员工数据不自动成为可自由商业化的 IP。
  • 能技术调用不等于可转售、再许可、训练或对外发布。
  • 法务/合同确认用途、地域、期限、保密、再许可、维护、退出与收益安排。
  • Discussion, invocation or demo does not transfer background ownership.
  • Customer or employee data is not automatically commercializable IP.
  • Technical access does not mean resale, sublicensing, training or publication rights.
  • Legal/contracts confirm use, territory, term, confidentiality, sublicensing, maintenance, exit and revenue terms.
现场记录：首场景带入资产｜ISS 可沉淀资产｜联合贡献与维护｜第三方/客户授权｜法务合同 Owner、日期与下一门。Record: assets brought into the first scene | ISS-retainable assets | joint contributions and maintenance | third-party/customer rights | legal/contracts Owner, date and next gate.
讨论记录Discussion record请记录一项资产的来源、可用范围、权利待确认点与领导意见。Record one asset’s source, allowed use, rights question and leadership view.

133 · MD §D2.4.2 · IP与商业化IP and commercialization
MD §D2.4.2 + D2.4.4 · Day 2MD §D2.4.2 + D2.4.4 | Day 2

从能力资产到可重复交付的业务产品From Capability Assets to Repeatable Business Products

讨论候选产品包，不宣布已售产品：客户问题、差异化、通用核心与配置必须和评测、部署维护、成本及 SLA 一起成立。Discuss candidate product packages, not sold products: customer problem, differentiation, core/configuration, evaluation, operations, cost and SLA must fit together.

候选产品必须回答Every candidate must answer

  • 客户/问题：面向谁，解决哪个可观察业务问题，首个范围与排除项是什么。
  • 差异化：哪些领域语义、规则、流程、评测、反馈或交付方法可复用。
  • 通用核心 + 配置：接口、编排、权限、日志、评测和运维是核心；规则、数据映射、工作流、角色和界面按客户配置。
  • Customer/problem: who is served, which observable problem, and what is in/out of scope.
  • Differentiation: reusable domain semantics, rules, workflows, evaluation, feedback or delivery method.
  • Core + configuration: interfaces, orchestration, access, logs, evaluation and operations are core; rules, mappings, flows, roles and UI are configured.

交付与产品化证据Delivery and product evidence

  • 评测：正常/异常/边界样本、专家判定、基线、质量、风险、成本和人工介入。
  • 部署维护：环境、接口、版本、回滚、告警、培训、支持、退出和责任人。
  • 成本/SLA：模型、算力、接口、实施、运维与人工成本；响应、可用性、异常和不适用边界。
  • 第二个受控场景必须记录复用项、客户差异、权限、语义和重新评测，不用一次演示证明泛化。
  • Evaluation: normal, exception and boundary samples, expert judgment, baseline, quality, risk, cost and intervention.
  • Deploy/maintain: environment, interfaces, versions, rollback, alerts, training, support, exit and owners.
  • Cost/SLA: model, compute, interface, implementation, operations and human cost; response, availability and limits.
  • A second controlled scene must record reuse, customer differences, access, semantics and re-evaluation.
候选方向：服务智能、Back Order/Customer Promise、CEC/Genesys、Service Supply Chain Decision、WMS/Warehouse Business Tooling；名称、客户、成熟度、价格和商业责任待验证。Candidate directions: service intelligence, Back Order/Customer Promise, CEC/Genesys, Service Supply Chain Decision, WMS/Warehouse Business Tooling; name, customer, maturity, price and commercial ownership remain to be validated.
产品化讨论记录Productization record请记录客户/问题、核心与配置、第二场景、权利状态、维护责任和领导意见。Record customer/problem, core/configuration, second scene, rights status, maintenance owner and leadership view.

134 · MD §D2.4.3 · IP与商业化IP and commercialization
MD §D2.4.3 · Day 2MD §D2.4.3 | Day 2

十二月后启动：客户验证、资源与决策门After December: Validation, Resources and Decision Gates

这里的“启动”是商业验证/试点/资源方向，不是未经审批的正式上市承诺；产品化从近期并行准备，不拖到两年后才讨论。“Start” means commercial validation, pilot or resourcing direction—not an unapproved launch promise; product preparation starts in parallel, not after two years.

先满足这些条件Conditions first

  • 客户/用户、问题、范围、排除项和愿意验证的结果清楚。
  • 真实/脱敏材料、正常/异常/边界样本、专家口径、基线与验收可用。
  • 通用核心、客户配置、部署、评测、日志、回滚、Training 与维护责任可拆分。
  • IP、数据、第三方许可、合同、法务、安全、采购和正式审批路径可审。
  • Customer/user, problem, scope, exclusions and desired evidence are clear.
  • Real/redacted material, normal/exception/boundary samples, experts, baseline and acceptance are available.
  • Core, customer configuration, deployment, evaluation, logs, rollback, training and maintenance are separable.
  • IP, data, third-party rights, contracts, legal, security, procurement and approval paths are reviewable.

启动后要做什么Tasks after the gate

  • 验证：客户/内部试点，比较业务结果、质量、成本、人工介入与复制工作量。
  • 交付：修正产品包、配置说明、SLA/支持边界、部署和退出条件。
  • 决策：按证据继续、缩小、暂停或转交；未批准不对外上市、不承诺客户或价格。
  • 责任：ISS Biz 业务 Owner；COO AI/ITEM 共建与交付；DT/安全/采购/法务按需。
  • Validate: customer/internal pilot; compare outcomes, quality, cost, intervention and replication effort.
  • Deliver: refine package, configuration, SLA/support, deployment and exit conditions.
  • Decide: continue, narrow, pause or transfer on evidence; no external launch, customer or price promise before approval.
  • Own: ISS Biz business Owner; COO AI/ITEM co-build and delivery; DT/security/procurement/legal as needed.
时间纪律：近期做问题、基线、授权和最小产品包；十二月后按批准进入验证/试点；更长期才依据价值和市场证据扩展。Timing: prepare problem, baseline, rights and minimum package now; enter validation/pilot after December only with approval; scale later on value and market evidence.
启动记录Launch-direction record请记录启动条件、缺口、Owner、日期、资源、领导意见与下一门。Record conditions, gaps, Owner, date, resources, leadership view and next gate.

135 · MD §D2.5.1 · 收敛与行动Convergence and action
MD §D2.5.1 · Day 2MD §D2.5.1 | Day 2

四项战略成果与四个执行决策字段Four Strategic Outcomes and Four Execution Fields

战略成果回答“ISS 要形成什么”，执行字段回答“第一轮如何负责任地开始”；两层必须接成同一条记录链。Strategic outcomes answer “what ISS should become”; execution fields answer “how the first round starts responsibly.” Keep them in one record chain.

① 目标运营蓝图① Target operating blueprint

未来两到三年的业务工作方式、人机分工、专家/主管/跨域协作和共用能力。落到字段①的首场景、用户、流程、基线与验收；字段②/③写角色与边界。

The two-to-three-year work model, human/AI roles, expert/manager/cross-domain collaboration and shared capabilities. Map to field ① scenario, users, flow, baseline and acceptance; fields ②/③ capture roles and bounds.

② 现状差距及突破主线② Gaps and breakthrough lines

以证据说明知识、数据、接口、评测、组织或采用机制的差距、影响与优先级。落到字段③已有/缺失输入，字段④补证、建设、停止或转交。

Use evidence to state gaps, impact and priority in knowledge, data, interfaces, evaluation, organization or adoption. Map to field ③ inputs and field ④ evidence, build, stop or transfer tasks.

③ 分层实施路线图③ Layered implementation roadmap

业务、组织、平台、产品四条泳道的阶段、依赖、资源、验收与下一门。字段②明确联合团队与 Owner；字段④记录实际阶段、交付、日期、投入与评审。

Business, organization, platform and product lanes with stages, dependencies, resources, acceptance and next gates. Field ② names the team and Owners; field ④ records stage, deliverable, date, investment and review.

④ 自主能力与商业化方案④ Own capability and commercialization

候选资产/产品、客户价值、权利边界、交付维护责任与启动条件。字段①写验证问题，字段③写授权/部署/评测，字段④写是否进入商业验证及正式审批。

Candidate assets/products, customer value, rights, delivery/maintenance accountability and start conditions. Field ① states the validation problem; field ③ rights/deployment/evaluation; field ④ commercialization and approval.

四字段：①首个共建场景与验收指标｜②联合团队与 Owner｜③能力输入与执行边界｜④推进方式与下一决策门。Four fields: ① first scenario and acceptance | ② joint team and Owners | ③ capability inputs and execution bounds | ④ path and next gate.
衔接记录Linkage record请记录每项战略成果进入哪个执行字段、缺什么证据及领导意见。Record which execution field carries each strategic outcome, missing evidence and leadership view.

MD §D2.5.1–D2.5.3 · Day 2

前四环节同步形成建议，末 30 分钟确认Build the Recommendation Across Four Blocks, Confirm in the Final 30 Minutes

D2.1–D2.4 持续补齐事实、证据、责任与边界；D2.5 将其压成四字段建议，末 30 分钟只确认状态与行动。D2.1–D2.4 build facts, evidence, ownership and bounds in parallel; D2.5 compresses them into four fields, and the final 30 minutes confirms state and action.

① SCENARIO / 场景与指标

首个共建场景与验收指标First scenario and acceptance

场景、问题、用户、范围、排除项、基线、指标、样本、专家判定、人工确认与门槛。

Scenario, problem, users, scope, exclusions, baseline, metrics, samples, expert judgment, human confirmation and thresholds.

② TEAM / 团队与 Owner

联合团队与 OwnerJoint team and Owners

ISS Biz、COO AI、ITEM；FDE、专家，以及数据、系统、审批、Training、运维和 DT 按需事项。

ISS Biz, COO AI, ITEM, FDE and experts, plus data, system, approval, Training, operations and DT as needed.

③ INPUT / 输入与边界

能力输入与执行边界Inputs and execution bounds

知识、数据、代码、模型、接口、Tools、Skill、Action、权限、部署、日志、评测、成本及真实/模拟/人工边界。

Knowledge, data, code, models, interfaces, Tools, Skills, Actions, access, deployment, logs, evaluation, cost and real/simulated/human boundaries.

④ PATH / 推进与门

推进方式与下一决策门Path and next gate

项目阶段、交付物、投入、时间、上线/回滚、继续/调整/停止、下一评审和依赖。

Project stage, deliverables, investment, timing, launch/rollback, continue/adjust/stop, next review and dependencies.

记录纪律：前四环节同步形成建议；末 30 分钟只确认状态、阻断证据、Owner、日期、投入、下一评审和正式审批/转交。未来能力保持“建议/待确认”。Recording discipline: build the recommendation across the four blocks; use the final 30 minutes only for state, blockers, Owner, date, investment, review and formal path. Keep future capability as recommended/pending.

问题、证据与正式审批依赖，不带模糊结论进门Issues, Evidence and Formal Dependencies

把不确定性拆成可追踪的缺口：事实证据、责任 Owner、正式路径和下一步，不用“应该可以”替代确认。Turn uncertainty into traceable gaps: evidence, accountable Owner, formal path and next step; do not replace confirmation with “should work.”

依赖类别本轮需核对的证据缺口如何进入 D2.6
业务材料与验收真实输入、规则、样本、基线、指标、专家判定与排除项补证缩小；明确 Owner、截止日期与复审门
数据 / 代码 / 接口 / 环境来源、版本、接口、部署边界、日志、留存与回滚有条件继续；列出前置条件与验证结果
权限 / 安全 / 模型授权访问范围、敏感知识、模型许可、人工接管与风险控制暂缓转交或正式安全路径，不把建议写成批准
预算 / 资源 / 运维所需投入、容量、Training、告警、成本与退出责任会中确认投入；由对应 Owner 带入下一评审
EA / BIA / 生产变更架构、业务影响、采购、上线与生产审批入口记录正式审批/转交，不由会议共识代替
DependencyEvidence to checkHow it enters D2.6
Business and acceptanceReal inputs, rules, samples, baseline, metrics, expert judgment and exclusionsNarrow with evidence; name Owner and review gate
Data / code / interface / environmentSource, version, interfaces, deployment, logs, retention and rollbackConditional continuation with prerequisites
Access / security / model rightsScope, sensitive knowledge, model license, takeover and controlsDefer or transfer to formal Security path
Budget / resources / operationsInvestment, capacity, Training, alerts, cost and exit ownershipConfirm in meeting; carry to next review
EA / BIA / production changeArchitecture, impact, procurement, launch and production approval pathRecord formal approval or transfer
规则：缺证状态保留“待确认”；事实来源、版本、权限和证据链接随记录保存。Rule: keep missing evidence as “pending confirmation”; retain source, version, access and evidence links.
讨论焦点Discussion哪一项依赖会阻断继续？应补什么证据、交给谁、何时复审，还是应缩小或转交？Which dependency blocks continuation? What evidence, Owner and review are needed, or should scope be narrowed or transferred?
